    class TreeViewMixin:
    """Render the plan tree, filter it by search query and fill the inspector."""

    def _apply_tree_node_styles(self) -> None:
        """Apply red/yellow styling to existing tree nodes based on active error/warning paths."""
        try:
            tree = self.query_one("#plan-tree", Tree)

            def _stylize_node(node: TreeNode) -> None:
                data = getattr(node, "data", None)
                if not data or not isinstance(data, dict):
                    for child in node.children:
                        _stylize_node(child)
                    return

                filepath = data.get("filepath", "")
                key = data.get("key", "")
                norm_fp = os.path.normpath(filepath) if filepath else ""
                norm_key = os.path.normpath(key) if key else ""

                is_crit = False
                is_warn = False

                if norm_fp and norm_fp in self.critical_error_paths:
                    is_crit = True
                elif norm_key and norm_key in self.critical_error_paths:
                    is_crit = True
                elif any(
                    p
                    and (
                        p == norm_fp
                        or p == norm_key
                        or p.endswith("/" + norm_key)
                        or p.endswith("\\" + norm_key)
                    )
                    for p in self.critical_error_paths
                ):
                    is_crit = True

                if not is_crit:
                    if norm_fp and norm_fp in self.warning_paths:
                        is_warn = True
                    elif norm_key and norm_key in self.warning_paths:
                        is_warn = True
                    elif any(
                        p
                        and (
                            p == norm_fp
                            or p == norm_key
                            or p.endswith("/" + norm_key)
                            or p.endswith("\\" + norm_key)
                        )
                        for p in self.warning_paths
                    ):
                        is_warn = True

                if isinstance(node.label, Text):
                    plain_txt = node.label.plain
                    new_txt = Text(plain_txt)
                    if is_crit:
                        new_txt.stylize("bold red")
                    elif is_warn:
                        new_txt.stylize("bold yellow")
                    node.label = new_txt

                for child in node.children:
                    _stylize_node(child)

            _stylize_node(tree.root)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Error applying tree node styles: {e}")

    def _has_file_nodes(self, plan_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Check if plan structure contains any document file nodes."""
        if not plan_dict or not isinstance(plan_dict, dict):
            return False
        for k, v in plan_dict.items():
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                if v.get("__type__") == "file":
                    return True
                if self._has_file_nodes(v):
                    return True
            elif isinstance(v, list) and len(v) > 0:
                return True
            elif isinstance(v, str) and k != "action":
                return True
        return False

    def _get_current_search_query(self) -> str:
        """Return lowercased search query string if search input exists and contains text."""
        try:
            search_input = self.query_one("#tree-search-input", Input)
            return search_input.value.strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            return ""

    def _build_matching_node_ids(
        self, plan_dict: Dict[str, Any], query: str, current_folder: str = ""
    ) -> Set[int]:
        """Perform a single O(N) bottom-up pass returning a set of dictionary object IDs matching the query."""
        matching_ids: Set[int] = set()
        if not query or not isinstance(plan_dict, dict):
            return matching_ids

        def _walk(d: Dict[str, Any], folder: str) -> bool:
            has_match = False
            for k, v in d.items():
                if isinstance(v, dict):
                    if v.get("__type__") == "file":
                        filepath = str(
                            v.get(
                                "filepath",
                                (Path(self.base_dir) / folder / k).as_posix()
                                if self.base_dir
                                else (Path(folder) / k).as_posix(),
                            )
                        )
                        target_filename = str(v.get("target_filename", ""))
                        if (
                            query in k.lower()
                            or query in filepath.lower()
                            or query in target_filename.lower()
                        ):
                            matching_ids.add(id(v))
                            has_match = True
                    else:
                        sub_folder = (Path(folder) / k).as_posix() if folder else k
                        folder_direct_match = (
                            query in k.lower() or query in sub_folder.lower()
                        )
                        child_match = _walk(v, sub_folder)
                        if folder_direct_match or child_match:
                            matching_ids.add(id(v))
                            has_match = True
            return has_match

        _walk(plan_dict, current_folder)
        return matching_ids

    def render_tree(self, search_query: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Render Textual Tree widget from in-memory plan structure without running validation worker."""
        try:
            tree = self.query_one("#plan-tree", Tree)
            tree.reset("Proposed Organization Plan")
            if search_query is None:
                search_query = self._get_current_search_query()

            query = search_query.strip().lower() if search_query else ""

            if not self._has_file_nodes(self.plan):
                tree.root.add_leaf(
                    "💡 Empty Workspace: No documents found in target directory",
                    data={"is_empty_state": True, "action": "info"},
                )
                tree.root.add_leaf(
                    "▶ Press [G] to Load Sample Dataset",
                    data={
                        "is_empty_state": True,
                        "action": "generate_sample_corpus",
                        "shortcut": "G",
                    },
                )
                tree.root.add_leaf(
                    "▶ Press [Ctrl+B] to Select Different Directory",
                    data={
                        "is_empty_state": True,
                        "action": "select_dir",
                        "shortcut": "Ctrl+B",
                    },
                )
            else:
                matching_ids = (
                    self._build_matching_node_ids(self.plan, query) if query else None
                )
                nodes_added = self._build_tree_nodes(
                    self.plan,
                    tree.root,
                    current_folder="",
                    query=query,
                    matching_ids=matching_ids,
                )
                if query and nodes_added == 0:
                    tree.root.add_leaf(
                        f"🔍 No matching tree nodes found for '{search_query}'",
                        data={"is_empty_state": True, "action": "info"},
                    )
            tree.root.expand_all()
            if tree.cursor_node and tree.cursor_node.data:
                self._update_inspector(tree.cursor_node, announce=False)
            elif getattr(self, "active_tree_node", None) and self.active_tree_node.data:
                self._update_inspector(self.active_tree_node, announce=False)
            else:
                self._update_inspector(None, announce=False)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error rendering tree: {e}")

    def rebuild_tree(
        self, search_query: Optional[str] = None, run_validation: bool = True
    ) -> None:
        """Rebuild Textual Tree widget from in-memory plan structure and optionally validate plan integrity."""
        self.render_tree(search_query=search_query)
        if run_validation:
            self.run_validation_worker()

    def _collect_file_nodes_from_dict(self, d: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Collect all file info dicts nested within a plan directory subtree."""
        files = []
        if not isinstance(d, dict):
            return files
        for val in d.values():
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                if val.get("__type__") == "file":
                    files.append(val)
                else:
                    files.extend(self._collect_file_nodes_from_dict(val))
        return files

    def _collect_visible_file_nodes_from_dict(
        self,
        node_dict: Dict[str, Any],
        current_folder: str = "",
        query: str = "",
        parent_folder_matches: bool = False,
        matching_ids: Optional[Set[int]] = None,
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Collect file info dicts for nodes visible under the active search query filter."""
        files = []
        if not isinstance(node_dict, dict):
            return files

        if not query:
            return self._collect_file_nodes_from_dict(node_dict)

        if matching_ids is None and query:
            matching_ids = self._build_matching_node_ids(
                node_dict, query, current_folder=current_folder
            )

        for k, v in sorted(node_dict.items()):
            if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("__type__") == "file":
                if parent_folder_matches or (
                    matching_ids is not None and id(v) in matching_ids
                ):
                    files.append(v)
            elif isinstance(v, dict):
                sub_folder = (
                    (Path(current_folder) / k).as_posix() if current_folder else k
                )
                folder_matches = query in k.lower() or query in sub_folder.lower()
                if (
                    parent_folder_matches
                    or folder_matches
                    or (matching_ids is not None and id(v) in matching_ids)
                ):
                    files.extend(
                        self._collect_visible_file_nodes_from_dict(
                            v,
                            current_folder=sub_folder,
                            query=query,
                            parent_folder_matches=parent_folder_matches
                            or folder_matches,
                            matching_ids=matching_ids,
                        )
                    )
        return files

    def _node_matches_query(
        self, key: str, val: Dict[str, Any], current_folder: str, query: str
    ) -> bool:
        """Check if a node (file or directory) or any of its descendants match the search query."""
        if not query:
            return True
        matching_ids = self._build_matching_node_ids(
            {key: val}, query, current_folder=current_folder
        )
        return id(val) in matching_ids

    def _build_tree_nodes(
        self,
        node_dict: Dict[str, Any],
        parent_item: TreeNode,
        current_folder: str,
        query: str = "",
        parent_folder_matches: bool = False,
        matching_ids: Optional[Set[int]] = None,
    ) -> int:
        """Recursively build tree nodes, filtering by search query if specified. Returns count of nodes added."""
        added_count = 0
        if query and matching_ids is None:
            matching_ids = self._build_matching_node_ids(
                node_dict, query, current_folder=current_folder
            )

        for k, v in sorted(
            node_dict.items(),
            key=lambda x: (
                1 if isinstance(x[1], dict) and x[1].get("__type__") == "file" else 0,
                x[0],
            ),
        ):
            if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("__type__") == "file":
                file_key = k
                file_info = v
                filepath = file_info.get(
                    "filepath",
                    (Path(self.base_dir) / current_folder / file_key).as_posix()
                    if self.base_dir
                    else (Path(current_folder) / file_key).as_posix(),
                )
                target_filename = file_info.get("target_filename", "")

                if query and not parent_folder_matches:
                    file_matches = matching_ids is not None and id(v) in matching_ids
                    if not file_matches:
                        continue

                is_locked = (
                    file_key in self.locked_files
                    or filepath in self.locked_files
                    or file_info.get("is_locked")
                )
                rating = self._ratings_cache.get(filepath) or file_info.get("rating")

                invalid_locks = getattr(self.plan, "invalid_locks", {}) or {}
                if not invalid_locks and isinstance(self.plan, dict):
                    invalid_locks = self.plan.get("invalid_locks", {}) or {}

                is_invalid_lock = (
                    filepath in invalid_locks
                    or file_key in invalid_locks
                    or (bool(filepath) and filepath.replace("\\", "/") in invalid_locks)
                    or (bool(filepath) and os.path.normpath(filepath) in invalid_locks)
                )

                is_excluded = file_info.get("is_excluded", False)
                if "is_checked" not in file_info:
                    is_checked = not is_excluded
                else:
                    is_checked = file_info.get("is_checked", True)
                if is_excluded:
                    is_checked = False
                file_info["is_checked"] = is_checked
                file_info["is_excluded"] = is_excluded

                cb_str = "[x]" if is_checked else "[ ]"
                label_parts = [cb_str]
                if is_invalid_lock:
                    label_parts.append("[LOCK WARNING]")
                elif is_locked:
                    label_parts.append("[LOCKED]")
                if is_excluded:
                    label_parts.append("[EXCLUDED]")

                source_root = file_info.get("source_root")
                if source_root:
                    root_name = os.path.basename(source_root) or source_root
                    label_parts.append(f"[ROOT: {root_name}]")

                if rating == "positive":
                    label_parts.append("[+]")
                elif rating == "negative":
                    label_parts.append("[-]")

                routed_by = file_info.get("routed_by")
                if routed_by == "jev_classifier" or file_info.get("is_jev"):
                    label_parts.append("[JEV]")

                sens_rating = file_info.get("sensitivity_rating")
                if sens_rating:
                    label_parts.append(f"[SENS: {str(sens_rating).upper()}]")

                arch_prio = file_info.get("archival_priority")
                if arch_prio is not None:
                    arch_str = (
                        f"P{arch_prio}"
                        if isinstance(arch_prio, int)
                        or (
                            isinstance(arch_prio, str)
                            and not str(arch_prio).upper().startswith("P")
                        )
                        else str(arch_prio).upper()
                    )
                    label_parts.append(f"[ARCH: {arch_str}]")

                target_filename = file_info.get("target_filename") or file_key
                target_path = None
                if self.base_dir:
                    target_path = os.path.normpath(
                        os.path.join(self.base_dir, current_folder, target_filename)
                    )
                elif current_folder:
                    target_path = os.path.normpath(
                        os.path.join(current_folder, target_filename)
                    )

                is_collision = (
                    file_info.get("collision")
                    or file_info.get("has_collision")
                    or False
                )
                if (
                    not is_collision
                    and target_path
                    and filepath
                    and os.path.lexists(target_path)
                ):
                    try:
                        is_same = os.path.samefile(target_path, filepath)
                    except Exception:
                        is_same = os.path.normpath(
                            os.path.abspath(target_path)
                        ) == os.path.normpath(os.path.abspath(filepath))
                    if not is_same:
                        is_collision = True

                pol = str(getattr(self.settings, "CONFLICT_POLICY", "rename")).lower()
                if is_collision:
                    label_parts.append(f"[COLLISION: {pol.upper()}]")

                label_parts.append(file_key)
                if target_filename and target_filename != file_key:
                    label_parts.append(f"-> {target_filename}")

                norm_fp = os.path.normpath(filepath) if filepath else ""
                norm_key = os.path.normpath(file_key) if file_key else ""

                is_crit_node = (
                    norm_fp in self.critical_error_paths
                    or norm_key in self.critical_error_paths
                    or any(
                        p
                        and (
                            p == norm_fp
                            or p == norm_key
                            or p.endswith("/" + norm_key)
                            or p.endswith("\\" + norm_key)
                        )
                        for p in self.critical_error_paths
                    )
                )
                is_warn_node = (
                    norm_fp in self.warning_paths
                    or norm_key in self.warning_paths
                    or any(
                        p
                        and (
                            p == norm_fp
                            or p == norm_key
                            or p.endswith("/" + norm_key)
                            or p.endswith("\\" + norm_key)
                        )
                        for p in self.warning_paths
                    )
                )

                label_str = cb_str + " 📄 " + " ".join(label_parts[1:])
                text_obj = Text(label_str)
                if is_crit_node:
                    text_obj.stylize("bold red")
                elif is_warn_node:
                    text_obj.stylize("bold yellow")

                node_data = {
                    "is_file": True,
                    "key": file_key,
                    "filepath": filepath,
                    "folder": current_folder,
                    "info": file_info,
                    "is_locked": is_locked,
                    "rating": rating,
                    "is_checked": is_checked,
                    "is_excluded": is_excluded,
                    "is_collision": is_collision,
                    "conflict_policy": pol,
                }
                parent_item.add_leaf(text_obj, data=node_data)
                added_count += 1
            elif isinstance(v, dict):
                sub_folder = (
                    (Path(current_folder) / k).as_posix() if current_folder else k
                )
                folder_matches = (
                    (query in k.lower() or query in sub_folder.lower())
                    if query
                    else True
                )

                if query and not (
                    parent_folder_matches
                    or folder_matches
                    or (matching_ids is not None and id(v) in matching_ids)
                ):
                    continue

                node_data = {
                    "is_file": False,
                    "key": k,
                    "folder": sub_folder,
                    "info": v,
                }
                child_files = self._collect_file_nodes_from_dict(v)
                if child_files:
                    checked_count = sum(
                        1
                        for f in child_files
                        if f.get("is_checked", True) and not f.get("is_excluded", False)
                    )
                    if checked_count == len(child_files):
                        folder_cb = "[x] "
                    elif checked_count > 0:
                        folder_cb = "[-] "
                    else:
                        folder_cb = "[ ] "
                else:
                    folder_cb = ""

                child_tree_node = parent_item.add(
                    Text(f"{folder_cb}📁 {k}"), data=node_data, expand=True
                )
                child_added = self._build_tree_nodes(
                    v,
                    child_tree_node,
                    current_folder=sub_folder,
                    query=query,
                    parent_folder_matches=parent_folder_matches or folder_matches,
                    matching_ids=matching_ids,
                )
                added_count += 1 + child_added

        return added_count

    def _update_inspector(self, node_or_data: Any = None, announce: bool = True) -> str:
        """Update and return formatted metadata text for the inspector panel and path comparison pane."""
        if node_or_data is None:
            node_or_data = self.active_tree_node

        data = None
        if hasattr(node_or_data, "data"):
            data = getattr(node_or_data, "data", None)
        elif isinstance(node_or_data, dict):
            data = node_or_data

        path_comp_widget = None
        try:
            path_comp_widget = self.query_one("#path-comparison", Static)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not data or not isinstance(data, dict):
            msg = (
                "Root folder of sorting plan."
                if getattr(self, "plan", None)
                else self._start_hint()
            )
            try:
                meta_widget = self.query_one("#meta-details", Static)
                meta_widget.update(msg)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if path_comp_widget:
                all_files = (
                    self._collect_file_nodes_from_dict(self.plan)
                    if hasattr(self, "plan") and self.plan
                    else []
                )
                if all_files:
                    path_comp_widget.update(
                        format_folder_path_comparison(all_files, self.base_dir)
                    )
                else:
                    path_comp_widget.update(
                        "Select a file or folder in the tree to compare source and target paths."
                    )
            return msg

        if data.get("is_empty_state"):
            action = data.get("action")
            if action == "generate_sample_corpus":
                msg = "Empty workspace node. Press [G] to create a sample dataset to try sorting on."
            elif action == "select_dir":
                msg = "Empty workspace node. Press [Ctrl+B] to select a different directory."
            else:
                msg = "Empty workspace node. No documents found in target directory."
            if announce:
                self.announce(msg)
            try:
                meta_widget = self.query_one("#meta-details", Static)
                meta_widget.update(msg)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if path_comp_widget:
                path_comp_widget.update("No documents available for path comparison.")
            return msg

        lines = []
        if data.get("is_file"):
            key = data.get("key", "")
            folder = data.get("folder") or "(Root)"
            locked = "Yes [LOCKED]" if data.get("is_locked") else "No"
            rating = data.get("rating") or "None"
            info = data.get("info") if isinstance(data.get("info"), dict) else {}

            src_filepath = data.get("filepath") or info.get("filepath") or key
            target_fn = info.get("target_filename") or key
            target_folder = folder if folder != "(Root)" else ""
            if self.base_dir and target_folder:
                target_filepath = os.path.join(self.base_dir, target_folder, target_fn)
            elif self.base_dir:
                target_filepath = os.path.join(self.base_dir, target_fn)
            else:
                target_filepath = (
                    os.path.join(target_folder, target_fn)
                    if target_folder
                    else target_fn
                )

            if path_comp_widget:
                table = format_side_by_side_path_comparison(
                    source_path=src_filepath,
                    target_path=target_filepath,
                    base_dir=self.base_dir,
                )
                path_comp_widget.update(table)

            lines.append(f"[bold accent]File:[/bold accent] {key}")
            lines.append(f"[bold]Path:[/bold] {data.get('filepath')}")
            lines.append(f"[bold]Target Folder:[/bold] {folder}")

            target_fn = info.get("target_filename")
            if target_fn:
                lines.append(f"[bold]Target Filename:[/bold] {target_fn}")

            lines.append(f"[bold]Locked:[/bold] {locked}")
            lines.append(f"[bold]ML Rating:[/bold] {rating}")

            invalid_locks = getattr(self.plan, "invalid_locks", {}) or {}
            if not invalid_locks and isinstance(self.plan, dict):
                invalid_locks = self.plan.get("invalid_locks", {}) or {}
            filepath_str = data.get("filepath", "")
            key_str = data.get("key", "")
            lock_err = (
                invalid_locks.get(filepath_str)
                or invalid_locks.get(key_str)
                or (
                    invalid_locks.get(filepath_str.replace("\\", "/"))
                    if filepath_str
                    else None
                )
                or (
                    invalid_locks.get(os.path.normpath(filepath_str))
                    if filepath_str
                    else None
                )
            )
            if lock_err:
                lines.append(f"[bold error]Lock Warning:[/bold error] {lock_err}")

            routing_src = info.get("routed_by")
            if routing_src:
                lines.append(f"[bold]Routing Source:[/bold] {routing_src}")

            cat = info.get("category") or info.get("jev_category")
            if cat:
                lines.append(f"[bold]Category:[/bold] {cat}")

            sens_rating = info.get("sensitivity_rating")
            if sens_rating is not None:
                lines.append(f"[bold]Sensitivity Rating:[/bold] {sens_rating}")

            sens_score = info.get("sensitivity_score")
            if sens_score is not None:
                try:
                    lines.append(
                        f"[bold]Sensitivity Score:[/bold] {float(sens_score):.2f}"
                    )
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    lines.append(f"[bold]Sensitivity Score:[/bold] {sens_score}")

            arch_prio = info.get("archival_priority")
            if arch_prio is not None:
                arch_str = (
                    f"P{arch_prio}"
                    if isinstance(arch_prio, int)
                    or (
                        isinstance(arch_prio, str)
                        and not str(arch_prio).upper().startswith("P")
                    )
                    else str(arch_prio).upper()
                )
                lines.append(f"[bold]Archival Priority:[/bold] {arch_str}")

            arch_score = info.get("archival_priority_score")
            if arch_score is not None:
                try:
                    lines.append(
                        f"[bold]Archival Priority Score:[/bold] {float(arch_score):.2f}"
                    )
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    lines.append(f"[bold]Archival Priority Score:[/bold] {arch_score}")

            conf = info.get("confidence")
            if conf is not None:
                try:
                    lines.append(f"[bold]Confidence:[/bold] {float(conf):.2%}")
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    lines.append(f"[bold]Confidence:[/bold] {conf}")

            if data.get("is_collision"):
                pol_str = str(
                    data.get("conflict_policy")
                    or getattr(self.settings, "CONFLICT_POLICY", "rename")
                ).upper()
                lines.append(
                    f"[bold warning]Collision Indicator:[/bold warning] [COLLISION: {pol_str}]"
                )

            if announce:
                self.announce(
                    f"Selected file '{key}' in folder '{folder}'. Locked: {locked}. Rating: {rating}."
                )
        else:
            key = data.get("key", "")
            folder = data.get("folder", "")
            folder_info = data.get("info", {})
            child_files = (
                self._collect_file_nodes_from_dict(folder_info)
                if isinstance(folder_info, dict)
                else []
            )

            if path_comp_widget:
                if child_files:
                    table = format_folder_path_comparison(
                        files_info=child_files,
                        base_dir=self.base_dir,
                    )
                    path_comp_widget.update(table)
                else:
                    path_comp_widget.update(
                        f"Folder category '{key}' contains no document items."
                    )

            lines.append(f"[bold accent]Folder Category:[/bold accent] {key}")
            lines.append(f"[bold]Relative Path:[/bold] {folder}")
            if announce:
                self.announce(f"Selected folder category '{key}' at path '{folder}'.")

        text = "\n".join(lines)
        try:
            meta_widget = self.query_one("#meta-details", Static)
            meta_widget.update(text)
        except Exception:
            pass

        return text

    def render_tree(self, search_query: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
    """Render Textual Tree widget from in-memory plan structure without running validation worker."""
    try:
        tree = self.query_one("#plan-tree", Tree)
        tree.reset("Proposed Organization Plan")
        if search_query is None:
            search_query = self._get_current_search_query()

        query = search_query.strip().lower() if search_query else ""

        if not self._has_file_nodes(self.plan):
            tree.root.add_leaf(
                "💡 Empty Workspace: No documents found in target directory",
                data={"is_empty_state": True, "action": "info"},
            )
            tree.root.add_leaf(
                "▶ Press [G] to Load Sample Dataset",
                data={
                    "is_empty_state": True,
                    "action": "generate_sample_corpus",
                    "shortcut": "G",
                },
            )
            tree.root.add_leaf(
                "▶ Press [Ctrl+B] to Select Different Directory",
                data={
                    "is_empty_state": True,
                    "action": "select_dir",
                    "shortcut": "Ctrl+B",
                },
            )
        else:
            matching_ids = (
                self._build_matching_node_ids(self.plan, query) if query else None
            )
            nodes_added = self._build_tree_nodes(
                self.plan,
                tree.root,
                current_folder="",
                query=query,
                matching_ids=matching_ids,
            )
            if query and nodes_added == 0:
                tree.root.add_leaf(
                    f"🔍 No matching tree nodes found for '{search_query}'",
                    data={"is_empty_state": True, "action": "info"},
                )
        tree.root.expand_all()
        if tree.cursor_node and tree.cursor_node.data:
            self._update_inspector(tree.cursor_node, announce=False)
        elif getattr(self, "active_tree_node", None) and self.active_tree_node.data:
            self._update_inspector(self.active_tree_node, announce=False)
        else:
            self._update_inspector(None, announce=False)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error rendering tree: {e}")

    class DropPlanConfirmModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[bool]):
    """Show the DropZone plan and ask before any file is moved."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    DropPlanConfirmModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 100;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    #drop-plan-tree {
        height: auto;
        max-height: 20;
        overflow-y: auto;
        border: solid $secondary;
        padding: 0 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, summary: str, plan_lines: List[str]):
        super().__init__()
        self.summary = summary
        self.plan_lines = plan_lines

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose the plan preview with Move and Cancel buttons."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading("Review DropZone Plan", level=1, classes="modal-title")
            yield Label(self.summary, id="lbl-drop-plan-summary")
            yield Static("\n".join(self.plan_lines), id="drop-plan-tree", markup=False)
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel-drop-plan")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Close without moving any files"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_move = Button(
                    "Move Files", id="btn-confirm-drop-plan", variant="success"
                )
                btn_move.tooltip = (
                    "Move the files as shown. You can undo it from History (Ctrl+Y)."
                )
                yield btn_move

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus Cancel so Enter never moves files by accident."""
        self.query_one("#btn-cancel-drop-plan", Button).focus()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-drop-plan")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm the moves."""
        self.dismiss(True)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-drop-plan")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel without moving anything."""
        self.dismiss(False)

    class DropZoneModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]
):
    """Floating overlay modal dialog for quick drag-and-drop or paste file triage."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS = {".txt", ".docx", ".csv", ".xlsx", ".xls", ".pdf"}

    CSS = """
    DropZoneModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: double $accent;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 100;
        min-width: 50;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 95%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .dropzone-target {
        border: dashed $primary;
        background: $surface;
        padding: 0 1;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        align: center middle;
        height: auto;
    }
    .dropzone-instructions {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $primary;
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .dropzone-subinstructions {
        color: $text-muted;
        text-align: center;
    }
    #input-queue-filter {
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .dropzone-split-container {
        height: auto;
        min-height: 8;
        layout: horizontal;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .narrow .dropzone-split-container {
        layout: vertical;
    }
    #dropzone-staging-table {
        width: 60%;
        height: 7;
        min-height: 5;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        border: solid $accent;
    }
    .narrow #dropzone-staging-table {
        width: 100%;
        height: 6;
    }
    #dropzone-metadata-preview {
        width: 40%;
        height: 7;
        min-height: 5;
        border: solid $primary;
        background: $surface;
        padding: 0 1;
        margin-left: 1;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow #dropzone-metadata-preview {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        min-height: 4;
        margin-left: 0;
        margin-top: 1;
    }
    .preview-header {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .preview-field {
        color: $text;
    }
    .status-text {
        color: $accent;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        text-style: italic;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 0;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    .queue-row {
        margin-top: 0;
        height: 3;
        align: center middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, DataTable:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    Button.hidden {
        display: none;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings: Any = None, base_dir: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self.base_dir = base_dir
        self.processed_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
        self.staged_items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose floating dropzone modal overlay controls."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Floating DropZone - Quick File Triage",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            with Vertical(classes="dropzone-target"):
                yield Label(
                    "📥 Drop or Paste File / Folder Paths Here",
                    classes="dropzone-instructions",
                )
                yield Label(
                    "Drag items onto terminal or paste absolute file paths to organize automatically",
                    classes="dropzone-subinstructions",
                )
            inp = Input(
                placeholder="Paste or drop file / directory paths here...",
                id="input-drop-paths",
            )
            inp.tooltip = (
                "Enter or drop target file or folder paths to trigger automated sorting"
            )
            yield inp

            filter_inp = Input(
                placeholder="Filter staged queue...",
                id="input-queue-filter",
            )
            filter_inp.tooltip = "Filter staged queue items by typing keywords (filename, path, status, extension)"
            yield filter_inp

            with Container(classes="dropzone-split-container"):
                table = DataTable(id="dropzone-staging-table")
                table.cursor_type = "row"
                table.tooltip = (
                    "Interactive staging queue displaying file status and details"
                )
                yield table

                with Vertical(id="dropzone-metadata-preview"):
                    yield Label("📋 Metadata Preview", classes="preview-header")
                    yield Label("Path: N/A", id="preview-path", classes="preview-field")
                    yield Label("Size: N/A", id="preview-size", classes="preview-field")
                    yield Label(
                        "Modified: N/A", id="preview-mtime", classes="preview-field"
                    )
                    yield Label(
                        "Status: N/A", id="preview-status", classes="preview-field"
                    )

            with Horizontal(classes="queue-row"):
                btn_filter = Button(
                    "Filter Unsupported", id="btn-filter-unsupported", variant="warning"
                )
                btn_filter.tooltip = "Remove unsupported file formats from the queue"
                yield btn_filter

                btn_remove = Button(
                    "Remove Item", id="btn-remove-item", variant="error"
                )
                btn_remove.tooltip = "Remove the selected row from the staging table"
                yield btn_remove

                btn_up = Button("Move Up", id="btn-move-up", variant="default")
                btn_up.tooltip = "Move selected item up in queue priority"
                yield btn_up

                btn_down = Button("Move Down", id="btn-move-down", variant="default")
                btn_down.tooltip = "Move selected item down in queue priority"
                yield btn_down

                btn_clear = Button(
                    "Clear Queue", id="btn-clear-queue", variant="default"
                )
                btn_clear.tooltip = "Clear all staged items from the modal"
                yield btn_clear

            status_lbl = Label(
                "Ready. Drop or enter paths above.",
                id="dropzone-status",
                classes="status-text",
            )
            status_lbl.tooltip = (
                "Live visual progress indicators and classification status messages"
            )
            yield status_lbl

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel dropzone triage operation and close dialog"
                yield btn_cancel

                btn_help = Button(
                    "Help", id="btn-help", variant="warning", classes="hidden"
                )
                btn_help.tooltip = (
                    "Open troubleshooting documentation for dropzone errors"
                )
                yield btn_help

                btn_process = Button("Sort Items", id="btn-process", variant="primary")
                btn_process.tooltip = (
                    "Start automated classification and relocation on dropped paths"
                )
                yield btn_process

    def _format_size(self, size_bytes: int) -> str:
        """Format size in bytes to human readable string."""
        if size_bytes <= 0:
            return "0 B"
        units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"]
        size = float(size_bytes)
        idx = 0
        while size >= 1024.0 and idx < len(units) - 1:
            size /= 1024.0
            idx += 1
        if idx == 0:
            return f"{int(size)} B"
        return f"{size:.1f} {units[idx]}"

    def get_filter_query(self) -> str:
        """Get lowercase trimmed search query from input-queue-filter field."""
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-queue-filter", Input)
            return inp.value.strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            return ""

    def get_filtered_items(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return list of staged items filtered by search query."""
        query = self.get_filter_query()
        if not query:
            return list(self.staged_items)
        return [
            item
            for item in self.staged_items
            if query in item["filename"].lower()
            or query in item["path"].lower()
            or query in item["extension"].lower()
            or query in item["status"].lower()
        ]

    def _refresh_table(self) -> None:
        """Re-render staging table with items matching active search filter."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
        except Exception:
            return
        table.clear(columns=True)
        table.add_columns("Status", "Filename", "Extension", "Size", "Full Path")
        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        for item in filtered:
            table.add_row(
                item["status"],
                item["filename"],
                item["extension"],
                item["size_str"],
                item["path"],
            )
        self.update_active_metadata_preview()

    def update_metadata_preview(self, item: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> None:
        """Update metadata preview card panel for given staged item."""
        if item is None:
            path_str = "N/A"
            size_str = "N/A"
            mtime_str = "N/A"
            status_str = "N/A"
        else:
            path_str = item.get("path", "N/A")
            size_str = item.get("size_str", "N/A")
            status_str = item.get("status", "N/A")
            if path_str and path_str != "N/A" and os.path.exists(path_str):
                try:
                    mtime = os.path.getmtime(path_str)
                    mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime).strftime(
                        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
                    )
                except Exception:
                    mtime_str = "Error reading timestamp"
            else:
                mtime_str = "N/A"

        try:
            self.query_one("#preview-path", Label).update(f"Path: {path_str}")
            self.query_one("#preview-size", Label).update(f"Size: {size_str}")
            self.query_one("#preview-mtime", Label).update(f"Modified: {mtime_str}")
            self.query_one("#preview-status", Label).update(f"Status: {status_str}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def update_active_metadata_preview(self) -> None:
        """Fetch item corresponding to current table cursor row and update metadata preview."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
            row_idx = table.cursor_row
            filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
            if row_idx is not None and 0 <= row_idx < len(filtered):
                self.update_metadata_preview(filtered[row_idx])
            else:
                self.update_metadata_preview(None)
        except Exception:
            self.update_metadata_preview(None)

    @on(Input.Changed, "#input-queue-filter")
    def on_queue_filter_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle search filter text changes to dynamically update visible table rows."""
        self._refresh_table()

    @on(DataTable.RowHighlighted)
    def _on_table_row_highlighted(self, event: DataTable.RowHighlighted) -> None:
        """Update metadata preview panel on table row focus/highlight."""
        self.update_active_metadata_preview()

    @on(DataTable.RowSelected)
    def _on_table_row_selected(self, event: DataTable.RowSelected) -> None:
        """Update metadata preview panel on table row selection."""
        self.update_active_metadata_preview()

    @on(DataTable.CellHighlighted)
    def _on_table_cell_highlighted(self, event: DataTable.CellHighlighted) -> None:
        """Update metadata preview panel on cell selection/focus."""
        self.update_active_metadata_preview()

    def stage_paths(self, raw_text: str) -> None:
        """Parse raw input string, expand directories, validate, and stage items."""
        raw_items = [
            p.strip().strip("'\"")
            for p in raw_text.replace("\r", "\n").split("\n")
            if p.strip()
        ]
        if not raw_items:
            return

        from app.core.scanner import get_files_recursively

        protected = (
            getattr(self.settings, "PROTECTED_PATHS", []) if self.settings else []
        )
        new_count = 0

        for item in raw_items:
            abs_p = os.path.abspath(item)
            if os.path.isdir(abs_p):
                # The scanner returns paths relative to the folder it walked.
                files = get_files_recursively(abs_p)
                for f_path in files:
                    self._add_single_file_to_staging(
                        os.path.join(abs_p, f_path), protected
                    )
                    new_count += 1
            else:
                self._add_single_file_to_staging(abs_p, protected)
                new_count += 1

        self._refresh_table()
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
            inp.value = ""
        except Exception:
            pass

        ready_cnt = sum(1 for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] == "Ready")
        msg = f"Staged {new_count} item(s). Queue total: {len(self.staged_items)} ({ready_cnt} ready)."
        self.update_status_msg(msg)

    def _add_single_file_to_staging(self, abs_p: str, protected: List[str]) -> None:
        """Validate and append a single file path to staged_items."""
        from app.core.mover import is_subpath_or_equal

        is_prot = False
        for prot in protected:
            if prot and is_subpath_or_equal(abs_p, prot):
                is_prot = True
                break

        filename = os.path.basename(abs_p) or abs_p
        ext = os.path.splitext(abs_p)[1].lower()

        if is_prot:
            status = "BLOCKED"
            size_bytes = os.path.getsize(abs_p) if os.path.exists(abs_p) else 0
        elif not os.path.exists(abs_p):
            status = "Not Found"
            size_bytes = 0
        elif ext not in self.SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS:
            status = "Unsupported"
            size_bytes = os.path.getsize(abs_p) if os.path.exists(abs_p) else 0
        else:
            status = "Ready"
            size_bytes = os.path.getsize(abs_p)

        size_str = self._format_size(size_bytes)

        if not any(item["path"] == abs_p for item in self.staged_items):
            self.staged_items.append(
                {
                    "path": abs_p,
                    "filename": filename,
                    "extension": ext,
                    "size": size_bytes,
                    "size_str": size_str,
                    "status": status,
                }
            )

    def filter_unsupported_items(self) -> None:
        """Remove items with 'Unsupported' status from the queue."""
        before = len(self.staged_items)
        self.staged_items = [
            item for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] != "Unsupported"
        ]
        removed = before - len(self.staged_items)
        self._refresh_table()
        msg = f"Filtered {removed} unsupported item(s) from queue. {len(self.staged_items)} item(s) remaining."
        self.update_status_msg(msg)

    def remove_selected_item(self) -> None:
        """Remove currently selected row from the staging table."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
            row_idx = table.cursor_row
        except Exception:
            row_idx = None

        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        if row_idx is not None and 0 <= row_idx < len(filtered):
            removed_item = filtered[row_idx]
            if removed_item in self.staged_items:
                self.staged_items.remove(removed_item)
            self._refresh_table()
            msg = f"Removed '{removed_item['filename']}' from queue. {len(self.staged_items)} item(s) remaining."
            self.update_status_msg(msg)
            new_filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
            if new_filtered:
                new_idx = min(row_idx, len(new_filtered) - 1)
                try:
                    table.move_cursor(row=new_idx)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.update_active_metadata_preview()
        else:
            self.update_status_msg("No item selected to remove.")

    def move_selected_item_up(self) -> None:
        """Move selected queue item up in priority."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
            row_idx = table.cursor_row
        except Exception:
            row_idx = None

        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        if row_idx is not None and 0 < row_idx < len(filtered):
            item_curr = filtered[row_idx]
            item_prev = filtered[row_idx - 1]
            idx_curr = self.staged_items.index(item_curr)
            idx_prev = self.staged_items.index(item_prev)
            self.staged_items[idx_curr], self.staged_items[idx_prev] = (
                self.staged_items[idx_prev],
                self.staged_items[idx_curr],
            )
            self._refresh_table()
            try:
                table.move_cursor(row=row_idx - 1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.update_active_metadata_preview()
            self.update_status_msg(
                f"Moved '{item_curr['filename']}' up in queue priority."
            )

    def move_selected_item_down(self) -> None:
        """Move selected queue item down in priority."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
            row_idx = table.cursor_row
        except Exception:
            row_idx = None

        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        if row_idx is not None and 0 <= row_idx < len(filtered) - 1:
            item_curr = filtered[row_idx]
            item_next = filtered[row_idx + 1]
            idx_curr = self.staged_items.index(item_curr)
            idx_next = self.staged_items.index(item_next)
            self.staged_items[idx_curr], self.staged_items[idx_next] = (
                self.staged_items[idx_next],
                self.staged_items[idx_curr],
            )
            self._refresh_table()
            try:
                table.move_cursor(row=row_idx + 1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.update_active_metadata_preview()
            self.update_status_msg(
                f"Moved '{item_curr['filename']}' down in queue priority."
            )

    def clear_queue(self) -> None:
        """Clear all staged items from modal queue."""
        self.staged_items.clear()
        self._refresh_table()
        self.update_status_msg("Cleared all staged items from the queue.")

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input on mount, render staging table, and announce modal opening."""
        self._app_ref = self.app
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self._refresh_table()
        try:
            self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input).focus()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce("Opened floating dropzone overlay for quick file triage.")

    def on_paste(self, event: events.Paste) -> None:
        """Handle clipboard paste event for dropped path payloads."""
        if event.text:
            try:
                inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
                inp.value = event.text.strip()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.stage_paths(event.text)

    @on(Input.Submitted, "#input-drop-paths")
    def on_input_submitted(self, event: Input.Submitted) -> None:
        """Handle enter key in drop paths input field to stage items or process queue."""
        if event.value.strip():
            self.stage_paths(event.value)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-filter-unsupported")
    def on_btn_filter_unsupported_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
        """Filter unsupported file formats button handler."""
        self.filter_unsupported_items()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-remove-item")
    def on_btn_remove_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
        """Remove selected item button handler."""
        self.remove_selected_item()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-move-up")
    def on_btn_move_up_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
        """Move item up button handler."""
        self.move_selected_item_up()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-move-down")
    def on_btn_move_down_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
        """Move item down button handler."""
        self.move_selected_item_down()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-clear-queue")
    def on_btn_clear_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
        """Clear queue button handler."""
        self.clear_queue()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-process")
    def on_btn_process_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
        """Handle Sort Items button press."""
        self.trigger_drop_triage()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-help")
    def action_help(self) -> None:
        """Open troubleshooting documentation link for dropzone."""
        url = getattr(
            self,
            "help_url",
            f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#dropzone-errors",
        )
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        notify(f"Opening help link: {url}", type="info", help_url=url)
        self.announce(f"Opened documentation link: {url}")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Dismiss dropzone modal."""
        self._close_pending_drop()
        self.announce("Cancelled dropzone modal dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def trigger_drop_triage(self) -> None:
        """Parse input paths if any, validate active queue, and trigger worker."""
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
            raw_text = inp.value.strip()
        except Exception:
            raw_text = ""

        if raw_text:
            self.stage_paths(raw_text)

        help_url = f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#dropzone-errors"

        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        ready_paths = [item["path"] for item in filtered if item["status"] == "Ready"]

        if not ready_paths:
            blocked_items = [
                item for item in filtered if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"
            ] or [item for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"]
            if blocked_items:
                err_text = f"Protected path blocked: {blocked_items[0]['filename']}"
            elif self.staged_items:
                err_text = "No ready files to sort in queue."
            else:
                err_text = "No file or folder paths provided."

            self._show_help_button(help_url)
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"DropZone error: {err_text}", type="error", help_url=help_url)
            self.update_status_msg(
                f"Protected path blocked: {blocked_items[0]['path']}"
                if blocked_items
                else f"Error: {err_text}",
                help_url=help_url,
            )
            return

        self.update_status_msg(f"Processing {len(ready_paths)} dropped item(s)...")
        self.run_drop_worker(ready_paths)

    def update_status_msg(self, msg: str, help_url: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Update live status message region and screen reader announcement."""
        display_msg = f"{msg} [Help: {help_url}]" if help_url else msg
        try:
            lbl = self.query_one("#dropzone-status", Label)
            lbl.update(display_msg)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce(msg, help_url=help_url)

    def _close_pending_drop(self) -> None:
        """Close the sessions of a planned but unexecuted drop."""
        for item in getattr(self, "_pending_drop", []):
            try:
                item["session"].close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._pending_drop = []

    @work(exclusive=True, thread=True)
    def run_drop_worker(self, target_paths: List[str]) -> None:
        """Plan the dropped items in a worker thread, then ask before moving."""
        app_ref = getattr(self, "_app_ref", None)
        self._close_pending_drop()
        pending: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        try:
            from app.core.pipeline import SortPipeline
            from app.core.scanner import get_files_recursively
            from app.core.session import AppSession

            # Plan every staged file in a folder together, so a dropped folder
            # is clustered as a whole instead of one file at a time.
            groups: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
            for path in target_paths:
                if os.path.isdir(path):
                    groups.setdefault(path, []).extend(get_files_recursively(path))
                else:
                    groups.setdefault(os.path.dirname(path), []).append(
                        os.path.basename(path)
                    )

            for base_dir, files in groups.items():
                if app_ref:
                    app_ref.call_from_thread(
                        self.update_status_msg,
                        f"Classifying {len(files)} file(s) in '{os.path.basename(base_dir)}'...",
                    )

                session = AppSession(self.settings, base_dir=base_dir)
                pending.append(
                    {
                        "path": base_dir,
                        "session": session,
                        "plan": None,
                        "file_count": len(files),
                    }
                )
                pending[-1]["plan"] = SortPipeline(session).plan(files)

            self._pending_drop = pending
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(self._confirm_pending_drop)
            else:
                self._confirm_pending_drop()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Error during dropzone classification: {e}")
            self._pending_drop = pending
            self._close_pending_drop()
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(
                    self.update_status_msg, f"Dropzone triage error: {e}"
                )

    def _confirm_pending_drop(self) -> None:
        """Show what the drop would do and wait for the user's go-ahead."""
        from app.core.domain_contracts import _make_json_serializable
        from app.core.plan_format import format_plan_tree

        lines: List[str] = []
        total_files = total_folders = 0
        for item in self._pending_drop:
            plan = _make_json_serializable(item["plan"])
            tree, n_files, n_folders = format_plan_tree(plan)
            if not n_files:
                continue
            total_files += n_files
            total_folders += n_folders
            lines.append(f"In {item['session'].base_dir}:")
            lines.extend(f"  {line}" for line in tree)

        if not total_files:
            self._close_pending_drop()
            self.update_status_msg("Nothing to sort: no files could be classified.")
            return

        summary = (
            f"Move {total_files} file(s) into {total_folders} folder(s)? "
            "Nothing has been moved yet."
        )
        self.update_status_msg(f"Review the plan: {summary}")

        def _on_answer(confirmed: Optional[bool]) -> None:
            if confirmed:
                self.update_status_msg(
                    "Relocating items according to generated sorting plan..."
                )
                self.run_drop_execute_worker()
            else:
                self._close_pending_drop()
                self.update_status_msg("Cancelled. No files were moved.")

        self.app.push_screen(DropPlanConfirmModal(summary, lines), _on_answer)

    @work(exclusive=True, thread=True)
    def run_drop_execute_worker(self) -> None:
        """Execute the confirmed drop plans in a worker thread."""
        app_ref = getattr(self, "_app_ref", None)
        pending = list(getattr(self, "_pending_drop", []))
        self._pending_drop = []
        processed_items = []
        failed_items = []
        outcomes = []
        try:
            from app.core.pipeline import SortPipeline

            for item in pending:
                try:
                    outcome = SortPipeline(item["session"]).execute(item["plan"])
                    outcomes.append(outcome)
                    processed_items.append(
                        {
                            "path": item["path"],
                            "summary": outcome.summary,
                            "file_count": item.get("file_count", 1),
                            "status": "success",
                        }
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.exception(
                        f"Error during dropzone relocation for {item.get('path')}: {e}"
                    )
                    failed_items.append(
                        {
                            "path": item.get("path"),
                            "error": str(e),
                            "file_count": item.get("file_count", 1),
                            "status": "failed",
                        }
                    )
                finally:
                    try:
                        item["session"].close()
                    except Exception:
                        pass

            succeeded_files = sum(i["file_count"] for i in processed_items)
            failed_files = sum(i["file_count"] for i in failed_items)
            total_items = len(pending)

            if not failed_items:
                status = "success"
                final_msg = (
                    f"Completed triage of {succeeded_files} dropped item(s): "
                    + " ".join(o.describe() for o in outcomes)
                )
            elif processed_items:
                status = "partial"
                err_summary = "; ".join(
                    f"{item['path']}: {item['error']}" for item in failed_items
                )
                descriptions = " ".join(o.describe() for o in outcomes)
                final_msg = (
                    f"Completed triage of {succeeded_files} item(s) "
                    f"({len(processed_items)} succeeded, {len(failed_items)} failed): "
                    f"{descriptions} Errors: {err_summary}"
                )
            else:
                status = "failed"
                err_summary = "; ".join(
                    f"{item['path']}: {item['error']}" for item in failed_items
                )
                final_msg = f"Dropzone triage failed for all {len(failed_items)} item(s): {err_summary}"

            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(self.update_status_msg, final_msg)

            result_dict = {
                "status": status,
                "processed_count": succeeded_files,
                "failed_files": failed_files,
                "items": processed_items,
                "failed_items": failed_items,
                "succeeded_count": len(processed_items),
                "failed_count": len(failed_items),
                "total_count": total_items,
            }
            self.processed_result = result_dict
            try:
                if app_ref:
                    app_ref.call_from_thread(self.dismiss, result_dict)
                else:
                    self.dismiss(result_dict)
            except Exception:
                pass
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Error during dropzone relocation: {e}")
            for item in pending:
                try:
                    item["session"].close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(
                    self.update_status_msg, f"Dropzone triage error: {e}"
                )

    action_cancel()

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
    """Compose floating dropzone modal overlay controls."""
    with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
        yield Heading(
            "Floating DropZone - Quick File Triage",
            level=1,
            classes="modal-title",
            id="modal-title",
        )
        with Vertical(classes="dropzone-target"):
            yield Label(
                "📥 Drop or Paste File / Folder Paths Here",

                )
                yield Label(
                    "Status: N/A", id="preview-status", classes="preview-field"
                )

        with Horizontal(classes="queue-row"):
            btn_filter = Button(
                "Filter Unsupported", id="btn-filter-unsupported", variant="warning"

            btn_filter.tooltip = "Remove unsupported file formats from the queue"
            yield btn_filter

            btn_remove.tooltip = "Remove the selected row from the staging table"
            yield btn_remove

            btn_up = Button("Move Up", id="btn-move-up", variant="default")
            btn_up.tooltip = "Move selected item up in queue priority"
            yield btn_up

            btn_down = Button("Move Down", id="btn-move-down", variant="default")
            btn_down.tooltip = "Move selected item down in queue priority"
            yield btn_down

            btn_clear = Button(
                "Clear Queue", id="btn-clear-queue", variant="default"
            )
            btn_clear.tooltip = "Clear all staged items from the modal"

        status_lbl = Label(

            classes="status-text",

        status_lbl.tooltip = (
            "Live visual progress indicators and classification status messages"

        with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):

    def filter_unsupported_items(self) -> None:
    """Remove items with 'Unsupported' status from the queue."""
    before = len(self.staged_items)
    self.staged_items = [
        item for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] != "Unsupported"
    ]
    removed = before - len(self.staged_items)
    self._refresh_table()
    msg = f"Filtered {removed} unsupported item(s) from queue. {len(self.staged_items)} item(s) remaining."
    self.update_status_msg(msg)

    def get_filtered_items(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return list of staged items filtered by search query."""
    query = self.get_filter_query()
    if not query:
        return list(self.staged_items)
    return [
        item
        for item in self.staged_items
        if query in item["filename"].lower()
        or query in item["path"].lower()
        or query in item["extension"].lower()
        or query in item["status"].lower()
    ]

    def move_selected_item_down(self) -> None:
    """Move selected queue item down in priority."""
    try:
        table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
        row_idx = table.cursor_row
    except Exception:
        row_idx = None

    filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
    if row_idx is not None and 0 <= row_idx < len(filtered) - 1:
        item_curr = filtered[row_idx]
        item_next = filtered[row_idx + 1]
        idx_curr = self.staged_items.index(item_curr)
        idx_next = self.staged_items.index(item_next)
        self.staged_items[idx_curr], self.staged_items[idx_next] = (
            self.staged_items[idx_next],
            self.staged_items[idx_curr],
        )
        self._refresh_table()
        try:
            table.move_cursor(row=row_idx + 1)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.update_active_metadata_preview()
        self.update_status_msg(
            f"Moved '{item_curr['filename']}' down in queue priority."
        )

    def remove_selected_item(self) -> None:
    """Remove currently selected row from the staging table."""
    try:
        table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
        row_idx = table.cursor_row
    except Exception:
        row_idx = None

    filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
    if row_idx is not None and 0 <= row_idx < len(filtered):
        removed_item = filtered[row_idx]
        if removed_item in self.staged_items:
            self.staged_items.remove(removed_item)
        self._refresh_table()
        msg = f"Removed '{removed_item['filename']}' from queue. {len(self.staged_items)} item(s) remaining."
        self.update_status_msg(msg)
        new_filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        if new_filtered:
            new_idx = min(row_idx, len(new_filtered) - 1)
            try:
                table.move_cursor(row=new_idx)
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.update_active_metadata_preview()
    else:
        self.update_status_msg("No item selected to remove.")

    @work(exclusive=True, thread=True)
def run_drop_execute_worker(self) -> None:
    """Execute the confirmed drop plans in a worker thread."""
    app_ref = getattr(self, "_app_ref", None)
    pending = list(getattr(self, "_pending_drop", []))
    self._pending_drop = []
    processed_items = []
    failed_items = []
    outcomes = []
    try:
        from app.core.pipeline import SortPipeline

        for item in pending:
            try:
                outcome = SortPipeline(item["session"]).execute(item["plan"])
                outcomes.append(outcome)
                processed_items.append(
                    {
                        "path": item["path"],
                        "summary": outcome.summary,
                        "file_count": item.get("file_count", 1),
                        "status": "success",
                    }
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception(
                    f"Error during dropzone relocation for {item.get('path')}: {e}"
                )
                failed_items.append(
                    {
                        "path": item.get("path"),
                        "error": str(e),
                        "file_count": item.get("file_count", 1),
                        "status": "failed",
                    }
                )
            finally:
                try:
                    item["session"].close()
                except Exception:
                    pass

        succeeded_files = sum(i["file_count"] for i in processed_items)
        failed_files = sum(i["file_count"] for i in failed_items)
        total_items = len(pending)

        if not failed_items:
            status = "success"
            final_msg = (
                f"Completed triage of {succeeded_files} dropped item(s): "
                + " ".join(o.describe() for o in outcomes)
            )
        elif processed_items:
            status = "partial"
            err_summary = "; ".join(
                f"{item['path']}: {item['error']}" for item in failed_items
            )
            descriptions = " ".join(o.describe() for o in outcomes)
            final_msg = (
                f"Completed triage of {succeeded_files} item(s) "
                f"({len(processed_items)} succeeded, {len(failed_items)} failed): "
                f"{descriptions} Errors: {err_summary}"
            )
        else:
            status = "failed"
            err_summary = "; ".join(
                f"{item['path']}: {item['error']}" for item in failed_items
            )
            final_msg = f"Dropzone triage failed for all {len(failed_items)} item(s): {err_summary}"

        if app_ref:
            app_ref.call_from_thread(self.update_status_msg, final_msg)

        result_dict = {
            "status": status,
            "processed_count": succeeded_files,
            "failed_files": failed_files,
            "items": processed_items,
            "failed_items": failed_items,
            "succeeded_count": len(processed_items),
            "failed_count": len(failed_items),
            "total_count": total_items,
        }
        self.processed_result = result_dict
        try:
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(self.dismiss, result_dict)
            else:
                self.dismiss(result_dict)
        except Exception:
            pass
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Error during dropzone relocation: {e}")
        for item in pending:
            try:
                item["session"].close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if app_ref:
            app_ref.call_from_thread(
                self.update_status_msg, f"Dropzone triage error: {e}"
            )

    @work(exclusive=True, thread=True)
def run_drop_worker(self, target_paths: List[str]) -> None:
    """Plan the dropped items in a worker thread, then ask before moving."""
    app_ref = getattr(self, "_app_ref", None)
    self._close_pending_drop()
    pending: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    try:
        from app.core.pipeline import SortPipeline
        from app.core.scanner import get_files_recursively
        from app.core.session import AppSession

        # Plan every staged file in a folder together, so a dropped folder
        # is clustered as a whole instead of one file at a time.
        groups: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        for path in target_paths:
            if os.path.isdir(path):
                groups.setdefault(path, []).extend(get_files_recursively(path))
            else:
                groups.setdefault(os.path.dirname(path), []).append(
                    os.path.basename(path)
                )

        for base_dir, files in groups.items():
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(
                    self.update_status_msg,
                    f"Classifying {len(files)} file(s) in '{os.path.basename(base_dir)}'...",
                )

            session = AppSession(self.settings, base_dir=base_dir)
            pending.append(
                {
                    "path": base_dir,
                    "session": session,
                    "plan": None,
                    "file_count": len(files),
                }
            )
            pending[-1]["plan"] = SortPipeline(session).plan(files)

        self._pending_drop = pending
        if app_ref:
            app_ref.call_from_thread(self._confirm_pending_drop)
        else:
            self._confirm_pending_drop()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Error during dropzone classification: {e}")
        self._pending_drop = pending
        self._close_pending_drop()
        if app_ref:
            app_ref.call_from_thread(
                self.update_status_msg, f"Dropzone triage error: {e}"
            )
