    def stage_paths(self, raw_text: str) -> None:
    """Parse raw input string, expand directories, validate, and stage items."""
    raw_items = [
        p.strip().strip("'\"")
        for p in raw_text.replace("\r", "\n").split("\n")
        if p.strip()
    ]
    if not raw_items:
        return

    from app.core.scanner import get_files_recursively

    protected = (
        getattr(self.settings, "PROTECTED_PATHS", []) if self.settings else []
    )
    new_count = 0

    for item in raw_items:
        abs_p = os.path.abspath(item)
        if os.path.isdir(abs_p):
            # The scanner returns paths relative to the folder it walked.
            files = get_files_recursively(abs_p)
            for f_path in files:
                self._add_single_file_to_staging(
                    os.path.join(abs_p, f_path), protected
                )
                new_count += 1
        else:
            self._add_single_file_to_staging(abs_p, protected)
            new_count += 1

    self._refresh_table()
    try:
        inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
        inp.value = ""
    except Exception:
        pass

    ready_cnt = sum(1 for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] == "Ready")
    msg = f"Staged {new_count} item(s). Queue total: {len(self.staged_items)} ({ready_cnt} ready)."
    self.update_status_msg(msg)

    def trigger_drop_triage(self) -> None:
    """Parse input paths if any, validate active queue, and trigger worker."""
    try:
        inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
        raw_text = inp.value.strip()
    except Exception:
        raw_text = ""

    if raw_text:
        self.stage_paths(raw_text)

    help_url = f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#dropzone-errors"

    filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
    ready_paths = [item["path"] for item in filtered if item["status"] == "Ready"]

    if not ready_paths:
        blocked_items = [
            item for item in filtered if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"
        ] or [item for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"]
        if blocked_items:
            err_text = f"Protected path blocked: {blocked_items[0]['filename']}"
        elif self.staged_items:
            err_text = "No ready files to sort in queue."
        else:
            err_text = "No file or folder paths provided."

        self._show_help_button(help_url)
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        notify(f"DropZone error: {err_text}", type="error", help_url=help_url)
        self.update_status_msg(
            f"Protected path blocked: {blocked_items[0]['path']}"
            if blocked_items
            else f"Error: {err_text}",
            help_url=help_url,
        )
        return

    self.update_status_msg(f"Processing {len(ready_paths)} dropped item(s)...")
    self.run_drop_worker(ready_paths)

        row_idx = table.cursor_row

    def update_metadata_preview(self, item: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> None:
    """Update metadata preview card panel for given staged item."""
    if item is None:
        path_str = "N/A"
        size_str = "N/A"
        mtime_str = "N/A"
        status_str = "N/A"
    else:
        path_str = item.get("path", "N/A")
        size_str = item.get("size_str", "N/A")
        status_str = item.get("status", "N/A")
        if path_str and path_str != "N/A" and os.path.exists(path_str):
            try:
                mtime = os.path.getmtime(path_str)
                mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime).strftime(
                    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
                )
            except Exception:
                mtime_str = "Error reading timestamp"
        else:
            mtime_str = "N/A"

    try:
        self.query_one("#preview-path", Label).update(f"Path: {path_str}")
        self.query_one("#preview-size", Label).update(f"Size: {size_str}")
        self.query_one("#preview-mtime", Label).update(f"Modified: {mtime_str}")
        self.query_one("#preview-status", Label).update(f"Status: {status_str}")
    except Exception:
        pass

    def update_status_msg(self, msg: str, help_url: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
    """Update live status message region and screen reader announcement."""
    display_msg = f"{msg} [Help: {help_url}]" if help_url else msg
    try:
        lbl = self.query_one("#dropzone-status", Label)
        lbl.update(display_msg)
    except Exception:
        pass
    self.announce(msg, help_url=help_url)

    class DirectorySelectModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Union[str, List[str]]]]
):
    """Modal dialog for choosing target base directory or presets."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    DirectorySelectModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .error-banner {
        color: $error;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .preset-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        height: auto;
        min-height: 3;
    }
    .sources-list {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        color: $text;
        border: solid $primary;
        padding: 0 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, current_dir: str = "", source_dirs: Optional[List[str]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.current_dir = current_dir
        self.added_via_btn = False
        if source_dirs:
            self.selected_sources = [
                d if str(d).startswith("/") else os.path.abspath(d)
                for d in source_dirs
                if d
            ]
        elif current_dir:
            self.selected_sources = [
                current_dir
                if str(current_dir).startswith("/")
                else os.path.abspath(current_dir)
            ]
        else:
            self.selected_sources = []

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_directory_path(path_str: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Validate if path_str exists, is a directory, and allows read access.

        Returns error message string if invalid, or None if valid.
        """
        if not path_str or not path_str.strip():
            return "Directory path cannot be empty."

        clean_path = path_str.strip()
        expanded = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(clean_path))

        try:
            if not os.path.exists(expanded):
                return f"Target directory does not exist: {clean_path}"

            if not os.path.isdir(expanded):
                return f"Path is not a directory: {clean_path}"

            if not os.access(expanded, os.R_OK):
                return f"Permission denied for directory: {clean_path}"
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"Invalid directory path: {exc}"

        return None

    def _show_error(self, message: str) -> None:
        """Display inline error banner, announce message, and focus input."""
        try:
            lbl = self.query_one("#lbl-error", Static)
            lbl.update(message)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce(message, priority="assertive")
        try:
            self.query_one("#input-dir", Input).focus()
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Input.Changed, "#input-dir")
    def on_input_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Clear error banner when user changes input text."""
        try:
            lbl = self.query_one("#lbl-error", Static)
            lbl.update("")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Select Target Directory",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            inp = Input(
                value=self.current_dir,
                placeholder="Enter absolute directory path...",
                id="input-dir",
            )
            inp.tooltip = "Enter absolute target directory path to scan"
            yield inp
            yield Static("", id="lbl-error", classes="error-banner")
            yield Label("Selected Sources:", id="lbl-sources")
            yield Static(
                self._format_sources_display(),
                id="static-sources-list",
                classes="sources-list",
            )
            yield Label("Quick Presets:")
            with Horizontal(classes="preset-row"):
                p_demo = Button("Demo Workspace", id="preset-demo", variant="default")
                p_demo.tooltip = "Select sandbox demo workspace quick preset"
                yield p_demo
                p_dl = Button("Downloads", id="preset-downloads", variant="default")
                p_dl.tooltip = "Select user Downloads folder quick preset"
                yield p_dl
                p_docs = Button("Documents", id="preset-documents", variant="default")
                p_docs.tooltip = "Select user Documents folder quick preset"
                yield p_docs
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_browse = Button("Native Browse", id="btn-browse", variant="default")
                btn_browse.tooltip = "Launch native OS directory browser dialog"
                yield btn_browse
                btn_add = Button("Add Path", id="btn-add-dir", variant="default")
                btn_add.tooltip = "Add current path to multi-root source list"
                yield btn_add
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel directory selection and close dialog"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button("Select", id="btn-confirm", variant="primary")
                btn_confirm.tooltip = "Confirm directory selection"
                yield btn_confirm

    def _format_sources_display(self) -> str:
        if not self.selected_sources:
            return "(No source directories selected)"
        return "\n".join(f"• {d}" for d in self.selected_sources)

    def _update_sources_widget(self) -> None:
        try:
            st = self.query_one("#static-sources-list", Static)
            st.update(self._format_sources_display())
        except Exception:
            pass

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit screen reader announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-dir", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened target directory selection dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-add-dir")
    def action_add_dir(self) -> None:
        """Add input directory path to selected source list."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input).value.strip()
        if not val:
            return
        err = self._validate_directory_path(val)
        if err:
            self._show_error(err)
            return

        abs_p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(val))
        if abs_p not in self.selected_sources:
            self.selected_sources.append(abs_p)
            self.announce(f"Added directory path: {abs_p}")
            self._update_sources_widget()
        self.added_via_btn = True
        try:
            self.query_one("#lbl-error", Static).update("")
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#preset-demo")
    def action_demo(self) -> None:
        """Select sandbox demo workspace preset."""
        from app.core.sample_corpus import generate_sample_corpus
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        path = os.path.abspath("sandbox/demo_workspace")
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            try:
                os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
                created_msg = f"Created demo workspace directory: {path}"
                self.announce(created_msg)
                notify(created_msg, type="info")
            except Exception as exc:
                err_msg = f"Failed to create directory '{path}': {exc}"
                self.announce(err_msg, priority="assertive")
                notify(err_msg, type="error")
                return

        try:
            generate_sample_corpus(path, overwrite=True)
            sample_msg = f"Generated sample corpus documents in '{path}'."
            self.announce(sample_msg)
            notify(sample_msg, type="info")
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error(f"Failed to generate sample corpus in '{path}': {exc}")
            err_msg = f"Failed to generate sample corpus: {exc}"
            self.announce(err_msg, priority="assertive")
            notify(err_msg, type="error")

        self.announce(f"Selected demo workspace preset: {path}")
        self.dismiss(path)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#preset-downloads")
    def action_downloads(self) -> None:
        """Select user Downloads directory preset."""
        path = os.path.expanduser("~/Downloads")
        err = self._validate_directory_path(path)
        if err:
            self._show_error(err)
            return
        self.announce(f"Selected Downloads preset: {path}")
        self.dismiss(path)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#preset-documents")
    def action_documents(self) -> None:
        """Select user Documents directory preset."""
        path = os.path.expanduser("~/Documents")
        err = self._validate_directory_path(path)
        if err:
            self._show_error(err)
            return
        self.announce(f"Selected Documents preset: {path}")
        self.dismiss(path)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm directory selection."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input).value.strip()
        if val:
            err = self._validate_directory_path(val)
            if err:
                self._show_error(err)
                return

            abs_p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(val))
            if not self.added_via_btn and len(self.selected_sources) <= 1:
                self.announce(f"Confirmed directory selection: '{abs_p}'")
                self.dismiss(abs_p)
                return

            if abs_p not in self.selected_sources:
                self.selected_sources.append(abs_p)

        if self.selected_sources:
            for source in self.selected_sources:
                err = self._validate_directory_path(source)
                if err:
                    self._show_error(err)
                    return

            self.announce(f"Confirmed directory selection: '{self.selected_sources}'")
            res = (
                self.selected_sources
                if len(self.selected_sources) > 1
                else self.selected_sources[0]
            )
            self.dismiss(res)
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled directory selection.")
            self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel directory selection."""
        self.announce("Cancelled directory selection.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Input.Submitted)
    def action_submit(self) -> None:
        """Submit input on Enter key press."""
        self.action_confirm()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-browse")
    @work(thread=True)
    def action_native_browse(self) -> None:
        """Launch native OS directory browser dialog in background worker thread."""
        from app.core.native_dialog import NativeDialogError, select_native_directory

        curr_val = ""
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input)
            curr_val = inp.value.strip()
        except Exception:
            pass

        initial_dir = curr_val or self.current_dir

        try:
            chosen = select_native_directory(initial_dir)
            if chosen:
                self.app.call_from_thread(self._on_native_dir_selected, chosen)
        except NativeDialogError as exc:
            self.app.call_from_thread(self._on_native_dir_failed, str(exc))
        except Exception as exc:
            self.app.call_from_thread(self._on_native_dir_failed, str(exc))

    def _on_native_dir_selected(self, path: str) -> None:
        """Handle decoded UTF-8 path string from native folder browser."""
        abs_p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(path))
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input)
            inp.value = abs_p
        except Exception:
            pass
        if abs_p not in self.selected_sources:
            self.selected_sources.append(abs_p)
            self._update_sources_widget()
        self.announce(f"Selected native folder path: {abs_p}")

    def _on_native_dir_failed(self, reason: str) -> None:
        """Handle native folder dialog failure by falling back to manual path entry."""
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        msg = "Native folder browser failed to launch. Please enter path manually."
        self.announce(msg, priority="assertive")
        notify(msg, type="warning")
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input)
            inp.focus()
        except Exception:
            pass

    class DuplicateReviewModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Dict[str, str]]]
):
    """Modal dialog for pre-move interactive duplicate cluster review and resolution."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    DuplicateReviewModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 90;
        min-width: 40;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .duplicate-card {
        background: $surface;
        border: solid $accent;
        padding: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .card-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
    }
    .card-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
    }
    .source-item {
        color: $text;
        margin-left: 2;
    }
    .action-select {
        margin-top: 1;
        width: 100%;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Select:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        duplicate_groups: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.duplicate_groups = duplicate_groups or []
        self.user_selections: Dict[str, str] = {
            g["group_id"]: g.get("default_action", "rename")
            for g in self.duplicate_groups
        }

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose duplicate review dialog widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Duplicate Cluster Review & Resolution",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Review duplicate destination target collisions before physical move execution:",
                classes="modal-subtitle",
            )

            with Vertical(id="duplicate-groups-list"):
                for group in self.duplicate_groups:
                    gid = group["group_id"]
                    tf_name = group.get("target_filename", "Collision")
                    t_dir = group.get("target_dir", "")
                    items = group.get("items", [])
                    default_action = group.get("default_action", "rename")

                    with Vertical(classes="duplicate-card", id=f"card-{gid}"):
                        yield Label(
                            f"Destination Target: {tf_name} ({t_dir})",
                            classes="card-title",
                        )
                        yield Label(
                            f"Colliding source files ({len(items)}):",
                            classes="card-subtitle",
                        )
                        for item in items:
                            rel_src = item.get("relative_source") or item.get(
                                "source_path", ""
                            )
                            yield Label(f"• {rel_src}", classes="source-item")

                        options = [
                            ("Rename (auto-number duplicates)", "rename"),
                            ("Keep Primary File Only", "keep"),
                            ("Skip Moving Duplicates", "skip"),
                        ]
                        sel = Select(
                            options,
                            value=default_action,
                            id=f"select-action-{gid}",
                            classes="action-select",
                            allow_blank=False,
                        )
                        sel.tooltip = (
                            f"Select deduplication resolution action for {tf_name}"
                        )
                        sel.aria_label = (
                            f"Resolution action for duplicate group {tf_name}"
                        )
                        yield sel

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                yield Button(
                    "Apply & Execute Moves",
                    variant="primary",
                    id="btn-confirm-duplicates",
                )
                yield Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel-duplicates")

    def _update_layout(self, width: int) -> None:
        """Update responsiveness based on modal container width."""
        if width < 60:
            self.add_class("narrow")
        else:
            self.remove_class("narrow")

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial widget on mount and announce to screen reader."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        if self.duplicate_groups:
            first_gid = self.duplicate_groups[0]["group_id"]
            try:
                self.query_one(f"#select-action-{first_gid}", Select).focus()
            except Exception:
                try:
                    self.query_one("#btn-confirm-duplicates", Button).focus()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        else:
            try:
                self.query_one("#btn-confirm-duplicates", Button).focus()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.announce("Opened interactive duplicate review modal.")

    @on(Select.Changed)
    def on_select_changed(self, event: Select.Changed) -> None:
        """Record user selection updates for duplicate groups."""
        if event.select.id and event.select.id.startswith("select-action-"):
            gid = event.select.id.replace("select-action-", "")
            if event.value is not None:
                self.user_selections[gid] = str(event.value)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-duplicates")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm deduplication selections and dismiss dialog."""
        self.announce("Applied duplicate resolution selections.")
        self.dismiss(self.user_selections)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-duplicates")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel duplicate review and abort execution."""
        self.announce("Cancelled duplicate review dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    class ManualPathFallbackModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[str]]):
    """Fallback modal dialog for manual directory path entry when native selection fails."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ManualPathFallbackModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $warning;
        width: 80%;
        max-width: 70;
        height: auto;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, current_dir: str = "", reason: str = ""):
        super().__init__()
        self.current_dir = current_dir
        self.reason = reason

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal fallback UI children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Label("Manual Directory Entry", classes="modal-title")
            if self.reason:
                yield Label(f"Native tool notice: {self.reason}", id="lbl-reason")
            yield Label("Please enter target directory path manually:")
            inp = Input(
                value=self.current_dir,
                placeholder="Enter absolute folder path...",
                id="input-fallback-dir",
            )
            yield inp
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button(
                    "Cancel", id="btn-cancel-fallback", variant="default"
                )
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button(
                    "Confirm", id="btn-confirm-fallback", variant="primary"
                )
                yield btn_confirm

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and announce screen reader alert."""
        self.query_one("#input-fallback-dir", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened manual directory entry fallback dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-fallback")
    @on(Input.Submitted, "#input-fallback-dir")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm manual path entry."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-fallback-dir", Input).value.strip()
        if val:
            abs_p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(val))
            self.announce(f"Confirmed manual directory entry: '{abs_p}'")
            self.dismiss(abs_p)
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled manual directory entry.")
            self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-fallback")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel manual path entry."""
        self.announce("Cancelled manual directory entry.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit screen reader announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-folder-name", Input).focus()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm folder creation action."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-folder-name", Input).value.strip()
        if val:
            self.announce(f"Confirmed folder creation for '{val}'.")
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled folder creation.")
        self.dismiss(val if val else None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel folder creation action."""
        self.announce("Cancelled folder creation.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Input.Submitted)
    def action_submit(self) -> None:
        """Submit input on Enter key press."""
        self.action_confirm()

    class ReassignModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[str]]):
    """Modal dialog for reassigning checked file nodes to a target category folder."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ReassignModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, existing_folders: List[str], count: int = 1):
        super().__init__()
        self.existing_folders = [f for f in existing_folders if f]
        self.count = count

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                f"Reassign {self.count} Selected File(s)",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Heading("Select Existing Target Folder:", level=2)
            options = [(f, f) for f in sorted(self.existing_folders)]
            if options:
                yield Select(options, prompt="Choose folder...", id="select-folder")
            yield Heading("Or Enter New Target Category Folder Name:", level=2)
            inp = Input(
                placeholder="e.g. Drafts, Financials, Archive",
                id="input-target-folder",
            )
            inp.tooltip = "Enter target folder category name"
            yield inp
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel reassign dialog"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button("Reassign", id="btn-confirm", variant="primary")
                btn_confirm.tooltip = "Confirm bulk reassignment"
                yield btn_confirm

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-target-folder", Input).focus()
        self.announce(f"Opened bulk reassign dialog for {self.count} items.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm reassign action."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-target-folder", Input).value.strip()
        if not val:
            try:
                sel = self.query_one("#select-folder", Select)
                if sel.value is not Select.BLANK and sel.value:
                    val = str(sel.value)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if val:
            self.announce(f"Reassigning to target folder '{val}'.")
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled bulk reassign.")
        self.dismiss(val if val else None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel reassign action."""
        self.announce("Cancelled bulk reassign.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Input.Submitted)
    def action_submit(self) -> None:
        """Submit reassign on Enter key press."""
        self.action_confirm()

    action_cancel()

    class RenameModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[str]]):
    """Modal dialog for renaming a file or folder node with pattern token formatting support."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    RenameModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .token-help {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-preview {
        color: $accent;
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        title: str,
        current_name: str = "",
        extension: str = "",
        category: str = "",
        file_date: str = "",
        seq: int = 1,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.modal_title = title
        self.current_name = current_name
        self.extension = extension
        self.category = category
        self.file_date = file_date
        self.seq = seq

    def _evaluate_preview(self, pattern_str: str) -> str:
        """Evaluate formatted pattern string for live preview."""
        from app.core.pattern_formatter import PatternTokenFormatter

        metadata = {
            "original": self.current_name,
            "extension": self.extension,
            "category": self.category,
            "date": self.file_date,
            "seq": self.seq,
        }
        fallback = (
            f"{self.current_name}{self.extension}"
            if self.extension
            else self.current_name
        )
        return PatternTokenFormatter.format_pattern(
            pattern=pattern_str,
            metadata=metadata,
            seq=self.seq,
            fallback_original=fallback,
        )

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                self.modal_title,
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            if self.extension:
                yield Label(
                    f"Extension '{self.extension}' is locked unless modified in template",
                    classes="modal-subtitle",
                )
            yield Label(
                "Tokens: {date}, {category}, {original}, {extension}, {seq}",
                classes="token-help",
            )
            inp = Input(
                value=self.current_name,
                placeholder="Enter new name or pattern (e.g. {date}_{category}_{original})...",
                id="input-name",
            )
            inp.tooltip = "Enter new file or folder name or pattern template"
            yield inp
            yield Label(
                f"Preview: {self._evaluate_preview(self.current_name)}",
                id="label-preview",
                classes="modal-preview",
            )
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel rename action and close dialog"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button("Rename", id="btn-confirm", variant="primary")
                btn_confirm.tooltip = "Confirm renaming action"
                yield btn_confirm

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit screen reader announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-name", Input).focus()
        self.announce(
            f"Opened rename dialog for '{self.modal_title}'. Enter new name or pattern and press Enter or click Rename."
        )

    @on(Input.Changed, "#input-name")
    def on_input_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Update live preview on input value change."""
        try:
            preview_str = self._evaluate_preview(event.value)
            lbl = self.query_one("#label-preview", Label)
            lbl.update(f"Preview: {preview_str}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm renaming action."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-name", Input).value.strip()
        formatted = self._evaluate_preview(val) if val else ""
        if formatted:
            self.announce(f"Confirmed rename to '{formatted}'.")
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled rename action.")
        self.dismiss(formatted if formatted else None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel renaming action."""
        self.announce("Cancelled rename action.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Input.Submitted)
    def action_submit(self) -> None:
        """Submit input on Enter key press."""
        self.action_confirm()

    action_cancel()

        Binding("f1", "close", "Close dialog", show=False),

    class ModelManagerModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[None]):
    """Modal screen for interactive local ONNX model management."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Close dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ModelManagerModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .field-label {
        margin-top: 1;
        color: $text;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .info-label {
        margin-top: 0;
        color: $text;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self._prev_is_downloading = False
        self._prev_status_text = ""

    def _resolve_model_dir(self) -> str:
        """Resolve primary model directory path."""
        try:
            from app.config import get_app_dir

            return str(get_app_dir() / "model")
        except Exception:
            return os.path.expanduser("~/.smart-autosorter/model")

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Interactive Model Management [Ctrl+K]",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )

            yield Heading("Model Status:", level=2, classes="field-label")
            yield Label(
                "Status: Checking...", id="lbl-model-status", classes="info-label"
            )
            yield Label(
                "Location: Checking...", id="lbl-model-path", classes="info-label"
            )
            yield Label("Size on Disk: 0 MB", id="lbl-model-size", classes="info-label")
            yield Label(
                "Verification: Checking...", id="lbl-model-hash", classes="info-label"
            )

            yield Heading(
                "Download Progress & Throughput:", level=2, classes="field-label"
            )
            pb = ProgressBar(total=100, show_percentage=True, id="progress-bar")
            pb.tooltip = "Active model download percentage progress"
            yield pb

            lbl_progress = Label("Idle", id="lbl-progress-status", classes="info-label")
            lbl_progress.tooltip = "Current download stage and throughput metrics"
            yield lbl_progress

            yield Heading("Network Proxy Options:", level=2, classes="field-label")
            proxy_val = getattr(self.settings, "PROXY", "") if self.settings else ""
            inp_proxy = Input(
                value=proxy_val,
                placeholder="http://proxy.example.com:8080",
                id="input-proxy",
            )
            inp_proxy.tooltip = "HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for model weight transfers"
            yield inp_proxy

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_start = Button("Start Download", id="btn-start", variant="primary")
                btn_start.tooltip = "Start downloading local ONNX model weights"
                yield btn_start

                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel-dl", variant="warning")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel active model download thread"
                yield btn_cancel

                btn_retry = Button("Retry Download", id="btn-retry", variant="primary")
                btn_retry.tooltip = "Retry or restart model download"
                yield btn_retry

                btn_delete = Button("Delete Model", id="btn-delete", variant="error")
                btn_delete.tooltip = (
                    "Unload in-memory model instances and delete local files"
                )
                yield btn_delete

                btn_close = Button("Close", id="btn-close", variant="default")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close Model Management dialog"
                yield btn_close

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial input, set polling timer, and announce modal launch."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-proxy", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened Model Management dialog.")
        self._refresh_ui_state()
        self.set_interval(0.2, self._poll_download_status)

    def _apply_proxy(self) -> str:
        p_val = self.query_one("#input-proxy", Input).value.strip()
        if self.settings:
            setattr(self.settings, "PROXY", p_val)
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        dm.update_proxy(p_val)
        return p_val

    def _refresh_ui_state(self) -> None:
        """Update model file info labels and control button states."""
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager, verify_downloaded_model

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()

        model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()
        onnx_file = os.path.join(model_dir, "model.onnx")
        tmp_file = os.path.join(model_dir, "model.onnx.tmp")

        lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-model-status", Label)
        lbl_path = self.query_one("#lbl-model-path", Label)
        lbl_size = self.query_one("#lbl-model-size", Label)
        lbl_hash = self.query_one("#lbl-model-hash", Label)

        lbl_path.update(f"Location: {model_dir}")

        model_exists = os.path.exists(onnx_file) and os.path.getsize(onnx_file) > 0
        tmp_exists = os.path.exists(tmp_file)

        if model_exists:
            size_mb = os.path.getsize(onnx_file) / (1024 * 1024)
            lbl_size.update(f"Size on Disk: {size_mb:.2f} MB")
            lbl_status.update("Status: Downloaded & Present")
            if verify_downloaded_model(model_dir):
                lbl_hash.update("Verification: Valid (Cryptographically Verified)")
            else:
                lbl_hash.update("Verification: Unverified or Missing Configuration")
        elif tmp_exists:
            size_mb = os.path.getsize(tmp_file) / (1024 * 1024)
            lbl_size.update(f"Size on Disk: {size_mb:.2f} MB (Incomplete)")
            lbl_status.update("Status: Downloading / Incomplete")
            lbl_hash.update("Verification: Pending Finalization")
        else:
            lbl_size.update("Size on Disk: 0 MB")
            lbl_status.update("Status: Missing (Not Downloaded)")
            lbl_hash.update("Verification: N/A")

        is_dl = dm.state["is_downloading"]
        self.query_one("#btn-start", Button).disabled = is_dl
        self.query_one("#btn-cancel-dl", Button).disabled = not is_dl
        self.query_one("#btn-retry", Button).disabled = is_dl
        self.query_one("#btn-delete", Button).disabled = not (
            model_exists or tmp_exists or is_dl
        )

    def _poll_download_status(self) -> None:
        """Periodic non-blocking timer callback to poll download status."""
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()

        is_dl = dm.state["is_downloading"]
        prog = float(dm.state["progress"])
        status_text = str(dm.state["status_text"] or "")
        err = dm.state["error"]
        succ = dm.state["success"]

        pb = self.query_one("#progress-bar", ProgressBar)
        pb.progress = min(100.0, max(0.0, prog * 100.0))

        lbl_prog = self.query_one("#lbl-progress-status", Label)
        if err:
            lbl_prog.update(f"Error: {err}")
        elif succ:
            lbl_prog.update("Download complete!")
        else:
            lbl_prog.update(
                status_text if status_text else ("Downloading..." if is_dl else "Idle")
            )

        if self._prev_is_downloading and not is_dl:
            if succ:
                self.announce(
                    "Model download completed successfully.", priority="polite"
                )
            elif err:
                self.announce(f"Model download failed: {err}", priority="assertive")
            elif "cancelled" in status_text.lower():
                self.announce("Model download cancelled.", priority="polite")

        self._prev_is_downloading = is_dl
        self._prev_status_text = status_text

        self._refresh_ui_state()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-start")
    def action_start_download(self) -> None:
        """Start background model weight download."""
        p_val = self._apply_proxy()
        from app.core.downloader import DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()
        try:
            dm.start_download(DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, model_dir, proxy=p_val)
            self.announce("Started model download.", priority="polite")
        except Exception as e:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"Download error: {e}", type="error")
            self.announce(f"Download error: {e}", priority="assertive")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-dl")
    def action_cancel_download(self) -> None:
        """Cancel active model download thread."""
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        dm.cancel_download()
        self.announce("Cancelled model download.", priority="polite")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-retry")
    def action_retry_download(self) -> None:
        """Retry model weight download operation."""
        p_val = self._apply_proxy()
        from app.core.downloader import DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        if dm.state["is_downloading"]:
            dm.cancel_download()
        model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()
        try:
            dm.start_download(DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, model_dir, proxy=p_val)
            self.announce("Retrying model download.", priority="polite")
        except Exception as e:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"Download error: {e}", type="error")
            self.announce(f"Download error: {e}", priority="assertive")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-delete")
    def action_delete_model(self) -> None:
        """Asynchronously delete local model files."""
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()

        def _on_done(success: bool, err: Optional[Exception]):
            if success:
                self.announce("Model deleted successfully.", priority="polite")
            else:
                self.announce(f"Model deletion failed: {err}", priority="assertive")

        dm.delete_model_async(model_dir, on_done=_on_done)
        self.announce("Deleting model weights...", priority="polite")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-close")
    def action_close(self) -> None:
        """Close model management dialog."""
        self.announce("Closed Model Management dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel and close model management dialog."""
        self.announce("Closed Model Management dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    action_cancel()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-delete")
def action_delete_model(self) -> None:
    """Asynchronously delete local model files."""
    from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

    dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
    model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()

    def _on_done(success: bool, err: Optional[Exception]):
        if success:
            self.announce("Model deleted successfully.", priority="polite")
        else:
            self.announce(f"Model deletion failed: {err}", priority="assertive")

    dm.delete_model_async(model_dir, on_done=_on_done)
    self.announce("Deleting model weights...", priority="polite")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-retry")
def action_retry_download(self) -> None:
    """Retry model weight download operation."""
    p_val = self._apply_proxy()
    from app.core.downloader import DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, DownloadManager

    dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
    if dm.state["is_downloading"]:
        dm.cancel_download()
    model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()
    try:
        dm.start_download(DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, model_dir, proxy=p_val)
        self.announce("Retrying model download.", priority="polite")
    except Exception as e:
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        notify(f"Download error: {e}", type="error")
        self.announce(f"Download error: {e}", priority="assertive")

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
    """Compose modal dialog children."""
    with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
        yield Heading(
            "Interactive Model Management [Ctrl+K]",
            level=1,
            classes="modal-title",
            id="modal-title",
        )

        yield Heading("Model Status:", level=2, classes="field-label")
        yield Label(
            "Status: Checking...", id="lbl-model-status", classes="info-label"
        )
        yield Label(
            "Location: Checking...", id="lbl-model-path", classes="info-label"
        )
        yield Label("Size on Disk: 0 MB", id="lbl-model-size", classes="info-label")
        yield Label(
            "Verification: Checking...", id="lbl-model-hash", classes="info-label"
        )

        yield Heading(
            "Download Progress & Throughput:", level=2, classes="field-label"
        )
        pb = ProgressBar(total=100, show_percentage=True, id="progress-bar")
        pb.tooltip = "Active model download percentage progress"
        yield pb

        lbl_progress = Label("Idle", id="lbl-progress-status", classes="info-label")
        lbl_progress.tooltip = "Current download stage and throughput metrics"
        yield lbl_progress

        yield Heading("Network Proxy Options:", level=2, classes="field-label")
        proxy_val = getattr(self.settings, "PROXY", "") if self.settings else ""
        inp_proxy = Input(
            value=proxy_val,
            placeholder="http://proxy.example.com:8080",
            id="input-proxy",
        )
        inp_proxy.tooltip = "HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for model weight transfers"
        yield inp_proxy

        with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
            btn_start = Button("Start Download", id="btn-start", variant="primary")
            btn_start.tooltip = "Start downloading local ONNX model weights"
            yield btn_start

            btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel-dl", variant="warning")
            btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel active model download thread"
            yield btn_cancel

            btn_retry = Button("Retry Download", id="btn-retry", variant="primary")
            btn_retry.tooltip = "Retry or restart model download"
            yield btn_retry

            btn_delete = Button("Delete Model", id="btn-delete", variant="error")
            btn_delete.tooltip = (
                "Unload in-memory model instances and delete local files"
            )
            yield btn_delete

            btn_close = Button("Close", id="btn-close", variant="default")
            btn_close.tooltip = "Close Model Management dialog"
            yield btn_close

    class QuarantineVaultModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[None]):
    """Interactive Modal Screen for Compliance Quarantine Vault & Audit Log Review."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Close quarantine vault", show=True),
        Binding("r", "release_selected", "Release file", show=True),
        Binding("d", "dismiss_selected", "Dismiss item", show=True),
        Binding("i", "reinspect_selected", "Re-inspect item", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+r", "refresh_records", "Refresh vault", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    QuarantineVaultModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    }
    .quarantine-modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $warning;
        width: 95%;
        max-width: 110;
        min-width: 60;
        height: 90%;
        min-height: 22;
        layout: vertical;
    }
    .narrow .quarantine-modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 98%;
    }
    .quarantine-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $warning;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .quarantine-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .quarantine-filter-row {
        height: 3;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        layout: horizontal;
    }
    #quarantine-search-input {
        width: 60%;
        margin-right: 1;
    }
    #quarantine-status-filter {
        width: 38%;
    }
    .quarantine-content-split {
        height: 1fr;
        layout: horizontal;
    }
    .narrow .quarantine-content-split {
        layout: vertical;
    }
    #quarantine-table-pane {
        width: 55%;
        height: 100%;
        border: solid $primary;
        margin-right: 1;
    }
    .narrow #quarantine-table-pane {
        width: 100%;
        height: 50%;
        margin-right: 0;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    #quarantine-detail-pane {
        width: 45%;
        height: 100%;
        border: solid $secondary;
        padding: 1;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow #quarantine-detail-pane {
        width: 100%;
        height: 50%;
    }
    .quarantine-detail-header {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .quarantine-detail-line {
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .quarantine-audit-header {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $primary;
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .quarantine-button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        layout: horizontal;
        align: right middle;
    }
    .quarantine-button-row Button {
        margin-left: 1;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus, DataTable:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        db: Optional[Any] = None,
        base_dir: str = "",
        policies: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.db = db
        self.base_dir = base_dir
        self.policies = policies or []
        self.records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.filtered_records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.selected_job_id: Optional[str] = None

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose quarantine vault modal widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="quarantine-modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Quarantine Vault & Compliance Audit Review [Ctrl+U]",
                level=1,
                classes="quarantine-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Inspect staged files, view structured audit logs, release, or re-inspect compliance items:",
                classes="quarantine-subtitle",
            )

            with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-filter-row"):
                inp = Input(
                    placeholder="Search by job ID, filename, policy reason...",
                    id="quarantine-search-input",
                )
                inp.tooltip = (
                    "Filter quarantine records by job ID, filename, or policy reason"
                )
                yield inp

                sel = Select(
                    [
                        ("ALL Statuses", "ALL"),
                        ("STAGED", "STAGED"),
                        ("QUARANTINED", "QUARANTINED"),
                        ("IN_INSPECTION", "IN_INSPECTION"),
                        ("RELEASED", "RELEASED"),
                        ("DISMISSED", "DISMISSED"),
                        ("DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE", "DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE"),
                    ],
                    value="ALL",
                    id="quarantine-status-filter",
                    allow_blank=False,
                )
                sel.tooltip = "Filter quarantine records by status"
                yield sel

            with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-content-split"):
                dt = DataTable(id="quarantine-table")
                dt.tooltip = "Table of staged quarantine compliance records"
                dt.cursor_type = "row"
                with Vertical(id="quarantine-table-pane"):
                    yield dt

                with Vertical(id="quarantine-detail-pane"):
                    lbl = Heading(
                        "Select an item to view audit log & details",
                        level=2,
                        classes="quarantine-detail-header",
                        id="quarantine-detail-title",
                    )
                    lbl.tooltip = "Audit log and metadata details panel"
                    yield lbl
                    st = Static(
                        "No quarantine item selected.", id="quarantine-detail-content"
                    )
                    st.tooltip = "Structured audit log timeline view"
                    yield st

            with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-button-row"):
                btn_rel = Button(
                    "Release (r)", id="btn-quarantine-release", variant="success"
                )
                btn_rel.tooltip = (
                    "Release selected quarantined item to destination directory"
                )
                yield btn_rel

                btn_dis = Button(
                    "Dismiss (d)", id="btn-quarantine-dismiss", variant="warning"
                )
                btn_dis.tooltip = (
                    "Dismiss selected quarantine item without relocating file"
                )
                yield btn_dis

                btn_insp = Button(
                    "Re-inspect (i)", id="btn-quarantine-reinspect", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_insp.tooltip = (
                    "Trigger background forensic scan and policy evaluation"
                )
                yield btn_insp

                btn_ref = Button("Refresh", id="btn-quarantine-refresh")
                btn_ref.tooltip = "Refresh quarantine vault records from database"
                yield btn_ref

                btn_close = Button("Close (Esc)", id="btn-quarantine-close")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close quarantine vault dialog"
                yield btn_close

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Initialize data table columns and trigger initial record fetch on mount."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        dt = self.query_one("#quarantine-table", DataTable)
        dt.add_columns("Job ID", "Filename", "Status", "Policy Action", "Created")
        self.announce("Opened Quarantine Vault modal.")
        self.action_refresh_records()

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Close quarantine vault modal on Escape key press."""
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-close")
    def action_close_button(self) -> None:
        """Close quarantine vault modal via close button."""
        self.dismiss(None)

    def _get_db(self) -> Any:
        if self.db is not None:
            return self.db
        from app.core.db_worker import DBWorker
        from app.core.store import open_store

        return open_store().database(DBWorker())

    def _call_ui(self, func, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
        try:
            app_obj = self.app
        except Exception:
            app_obj = None

        if app_obj and hasattr(app_obj, "call_from_thread"):
            try:
                app_obj.call_from_thread(func, *args, **kwargs)
                return
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            func(*args, **kwargs)
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-refresh")
    def action_refresh_records(self) -> None:
        """Refresh quarantine records from database."""
        self.fetch_records_async()

    @work(thread=True)
    def fetch_records_async(self) -> None:
        """Fetch quarantine records asynchronously on background worker thread."""
        try:
            db_inst = self._get_db()

            if self.base_dir:
                recs = db_inst.get_quarantine_records_by_base_dir(self.base_dir)
            else:
                recs = db_inst.get_all_quarantine_records()
            self._call_ui(self._on_records_loaded, recs)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Failed to fetch quarantine records: {e}")
            self._call_ui(self._on_records_loaded, [])
            self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Error loading quarantine records: {e}")

    def _on_records_loaded(self, records: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        self.records = records
        self._apply_filters()
        self.announce(f"Loaded {len(records)} quarantine record(s).")

    @on(Input.Changed, "#quarantine-search-input")
    @on(Select.Changed, "#quarantine-status-filter")
    def _on_filter_changed(self) -> None:
        self._apply_filters()

    def _apply_filters(self) -> None:
        search_term = ""
        status_term = "ALL"
        try:
            search_term = (
                self.query_one("#quarantine-search-input", Input).value.strip().lower()
            )
            status_term = str(
                self.query_one("#quarantine-status-filter", Select).value or "ALL"
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        filtered = []
        for r in self.records:
            st = r.get("status", "")
            if status_term != "ALL" and st != status_term:
                continue

            if search_term:
                job_id = (r.get("job_id") or "").lower()
                orig_file = (r.get("original_filepath") or "").lower()
                staged_file = (r.get("staged_filepath") or "").lower()
                action = (r.get("policy_action") or "").lower()
                if (
                    search_term not in job_id
                    and search_term not in orig_file
                    and search_term not in staged_file
                    and search_term not in action
                    and search_term not in st.lower()
                ):
                    continue
            filtered.append(r)

        self.filtered_records = filtered
        dt = self.query_one("#quarantine-table", DataTable)
        dt.clear()

        for r in filtered:
            job_id = r.get("job_id", "")
            orig_path = r.get("original_filepath", "")
            fname = os.path.basename(orig_path) if orig_path else job_id
            st = r.get("status", "")
            act = r.get("policy_action") or "-"
            created_ts = r.get("created_at", 0)
            created_str = (
                time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(created_ts))
                if created_ts
                else "-"
            )
            dt.add_row(job_id, fname, st, act, created_str, key=job_id)

        if filtered:
            if not self.selected_job_id or not any(
                x.get("job_id") == self.selected_job_id for x in filtered
            ):
                self.selected_job_id = filtered[0].get("job_id")
            self._render_detail_pane(self.selected_job_id)
        else:
            self.selected_job_id = None
            self._render_detail_pane(None)

    @on(DataTable.RowSelected)
    def _on_row_selected(self, event: DataTable.RowSelected) -> None:
        if event.row_key and event.row_key.value:
            self.selected_job_id = event.row_key.value
            self._render_detail_pane(self.selected_job_id)

    @on(DataTable.CellHighlighted)
    def _on_cell_highlighted(self, event: DataTable.CellHighlighted) -> None:
        if event.coordinate and (dt := self.query_one("#quarantine-table", DataTable)):
            try:
                row_key = dt.coordinate_to_cell_key(event.coordinate).row_key
                if row_key and row_key.value:
                    self.selected_job_id = row_key.value
                    self._render_detail_pane(self.selected_job_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _get_selected_record(self, job_id: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if not job_id:
            return None
        for r in self.records:
            if r.get("job_id") == job_id:
                return r
        return None

    def _render_detail_pane(self, job_id: Optional[str]) -> None:
        try:
            title_lbl = self.query_one("#quarantine-detail-title", Label)
            content_st = self.query_one("#quarantine-detail-content", Static)
        except Exception:
            return

        record = self._get_selected_record(job_id)
        if not record:
            title_lbl.update("No item selected")
            content_st.update(
                "Select a row in the quarantine table to view its detailed structured audit log."
            )
            return

        title_lbl.update(f"Job Details: {record.get('job_id')}")

        lines = [
            f"[bold]Original Path:[/bold] {record.get('original_filepath', '-')}",
            f"[bold]Staged Path:[/bold] {record.get('staged_filepath', '-')}",
            f"[bold]Status:[/bold] {record.get('status', '-')}",
            f"[bold]Policy Action:[/bold] {record.get('policy_action') or '-'}",
            f"[bold]File Hash:[/bold] {record.get('file_hash') or '-'}",
            f"[bold]Base Directory:[/bold] {record.get('base_dir', '-')}",
        ]
        if err := record.get("error_message"):
            lines.append(f"[bold red]Error:[/bold red] {err}")

        lines.append("")
        lines.append("[bold cyan]Structured Audit Log Timeline:[/bold cyan]")
        audit_log = record.get("audit_log", [])
        if audit_log:
            for entry in audit_log:
                if isinstance(entry, dict):
                    ts = entry.get("timestamp", 0)
                    ts_str = (
                        time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts))
                        if ts
                        else "--:--:--"
                    )
                    st = entry.get("status", "")
                    det = entry.get("details", "")
                    lines.append(f"  [dim]{ts_str}[/dim] [bold]{st}[/bold]: {det}")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"  • {entry}")
        else:
            lines.append("  (No audit log entries recorded)")

        content_st.update("\n".join(lines))

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-release")
    def action_release_selected(self) -> None:
        """Prompt destination directory and release selected quarantine item."""
        record = self._get_selected_record(self.selected_job_id)
        if not record:
            self.announce("No quarantine item selected for release.")
            return

        if record.get("status") == "RELEASED":
            self.announce(
                f"Quarantine item '{record.get('job_id')}' is already released."
            )
            return

        staged_path = record.get("staged_filepath")
        if not staged_path or not os.path.exists(staged_path):
            self.announce(
                f"Cannot release item '{record.get('job_id')}': Staged file missing at {staged_path}."
            )
            return

        orig_rel = record.get("original_filepath", "released_file")
        base_dir = record.get("base_dir") or self.base_dir or "."

        def _dir_selected_callback(target_dir: Optional[str]) -> None:
            if not target_dir:
                self.announce("Release operation cancelled.")
                return
            if not os.path.exists(target_dir) or not os.path.isdir(target_dir):
                from app.ui.notifications import notify

                err_msg = f"Target directory does not exist: {target_dir}"
                self.announce(err_msg, priority="assertive")
                notify(err_msg, type="error")
                return
            dest_file_path = os.path.join(target_dir, os.path.basename(orig_rel))
            self.execute_release_async(record, dest_file_path)

        self.app.push_screen(DirectorySelectModal(base_dir), _dir_selected_callback)

    @work(thread=True)
    def execute_release_async(self, record: dict, dest_file_path: str) -> None:
        """Asynchronously perform atomic quarantine relocation to destination path."""
        job_id = record["job_id"]
        staged_path = record["staged_filepath"]
        try:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest_file_path), exist_ok=True)
            from app.core.resilient_file_ops import atomic_quarantine_relocation

            with atomic_quarantine_relocation(staged_path, dest_file_path):
                db_inst = self._get_db()
                db_inst.update_quarantine_status(
                    job_id=job_id,
                    status="RELEASED",
                    audit_entry={
                        "timestamp": time.time(),
                        "status": "RELEASED",
                        "details": f"Released from quarantine modal to {dest_file_path}",
                    },
                )
            self._call_ui(self._on_release_success, job_id, dest_file_path)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to release quarantine job {job_id}: {e}")
            self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Release failed for {job_id}: {e}")

    def _on_release_success(self, job_id: str, dest_file_path: str) -> None:
        self.announce(
            f"Quarantine item '{job_id}' released successfully to {dest_file_path}."
        )
        self.fetch_records_async()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-dismiss")
    def action_dismiss_selected(self) -> None:
        """Dismiss the selected quarantine item without restoring file."""
        record = self._get_selected_record(self.selected_job_id)
        if not record:
            self.announce("No quarantine item selected for dismissal.")
            return

        if record.get("status") == "DISMISSED":
            self.announce(
                f"Quarantine item '{record.get('job_id')}' is already dismissed."
            )
            return

        self.execute_dismiss_async(record["job_id"])

    @work(thread=True)
    def execute_dismiss_async(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        """Asynchronously mark quarantine item as dismissed in database."""
        try:
            db_inst = self._get_db()
            db_inst.update_quarantine_status(
                job_id=job_id,
                status="DISMISSED",
                audit_entry={
                    "timestamp": time.time(),
                    "status": "DISMISSED",
                    "details": "Dismissed manually via quarantine vault modal review",
                },
            )
            self._call_ui(self._on_dismiss_success, job_id)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to dismiss quarantine job {job_id}: {e}")
            self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Dismiss failed for {job_id}: {e}")

    def _on_dismiss_success(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        self.announce(f"Quarantine item '{job_id}' marked as DISMISSED.")
        self.fetch_records_async()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-reinspect")
    def action_reinspect_selected(self) -> None:
        """Trigger background forensic re-inspection scan for selected item."""
        record = self._get_selected_record(self.selected_job_id)
        if not record:
            self.announce("No quarantine item selected for re-inspection.")
            return

        job_id = record["job_id"]
        self.announce(
            f"Initiating background forensic re-inspection for item '{job_id}'..."
        )
        self.execute_reinspect_async(job_id)

    @work(thread=True)
    def execute_reinspect_async(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        """Asynchronously execute policy re-inspection on worker thread."""
        try:
            db_inst = self._get_db()

            from app.core.quarantine_interceptor import QuarantineInterceptorService

            service = QuarantineInterceptorService(db=db_inst, policies=self.policies)
            res = service.process_quarantine_job(job_id)
            self._call_ui(self._on_reinspect_success, job_id, res)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to re-inspect quarantine job {job_id}: {e}")
            self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Re-inspection failed for {job_id}: {e}")

    def _on_reinspect_success(self, job_id: str, res: dict) -> None:
        new_st = res.get("status", "UPDATED")
        self.announce(
            f"Re-inspection completed for '{job_id}'. Resulting status: {new_st}."
        )
        self.fetch_records_async()

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
    """Compose quarantine vault modal widgets."""
    with Vertical(classes="quarantine-modal-box"):
        yield Heading(
            "Quarantine Vault & Compliance Audit Review [Ctrl+U]",
            level=1,
            classes="quarantine-title",
            id="modal-title",
        )
        yield Label(
            "Inspect staged files, view structured audit logs, release, or re-inspect compliance items:",
            classes="quarantine-subtitle",
        )

        with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-filter-row"):
            inp = Input(
                placeholder="Search by job ID, filename, policy reason...",
                id="quarantine-search-input",
            )
            inp.tooltip = (
                "Filter quarantine records by job ID, filename, or policy reason"
            )
            yield inp

            sel = Select(
                [
                    ("ALL Statuses", "ALL"),
                    ("STAGED", "STAGED"),
                    ("QUARANTINED", "QUARANTINED"),
                    ("IN_INSPECTION", "IN_INSPECTION"),
                    ("RELEASED", "RELEASED"),
                    ("DISMISSED", "DISMISSED"),
                    ("DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE", "DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE"),
                ],
                value="ALL",
                id="quarantine-status-filter",
                allow_blank=False,
            )
            sel.tooltip = "Filter quarantine records by status"
            yield sel

        with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-content-split"):
            dt = DataTable(id="quarantine-table")
            dt.tooltip = "Table of staged quarantine compliance records"
            dt.cursor_type = "row"
            with Vertical(id="quarantine-table-pane"):
                yield dt

            with Vertical(id="quarantine-detail-pane"):
                lbl = Heading(
                    "Select an item to view audit log & details",
                    level=2,
                    classes="quarantine-detail-header",
                    id="quarantine-detail-title",
                )
                lbl.tooltip = "Audit log and metadata details panel"
                yield lbl
                st = Static(
                    "No quarantine item selected.", id="quarantine-detail-content"
                )
                st.tooltip = "Structured audit log timeline view"
                yield st

        with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-button-row"):
            btn_rel = Button(
                "Release (r)", id="btn-quarantine-release", variant="success"
            )
            btn_rel.tooltip = (
                "Release selected quarantined item to destination directory"
            )
            yield btn_rel

            btn_dis = Button(
                "Dismiss (d)", id="btn-quarantine-dismiss", variant="warning"
            )
            btn_dis.tooltip = (
                "Dismiss selected quarantine item without relocating file"
            )
            yield btn_dis

            btn_insp = Button(
                "Re-inspect (i)", id="btn-quarantine-reinspect", variant="primary"
            )
            btn_insp.tooltip = (
                "Trigger background forensic scan and policy evaluation"
            )
            yield btn_insp

            btn_ref = Button("Refresh", id="btn-quarantine-refresh")
            btn_ref.tooltip = "Refresh quarantine vault records from database"
            yield btn_ref

            btn_close = Button("Close (Esc)", id="btn-quarantine-close")
            btn_close.tooltip = "Close quarantine vault dialog"
            yield btn_close

    @work(thread=True)
def fetch_records_async(self) -> None:
    """Fetch quarantine records asynchronously on background worker thread."""
    try:
        db_inst = self._get_db()

        if self.base_dir:
            recs = db_inst.get_quarantine_records_by_base_dir(self.base_dir)
        else:
            recs = db_inst.get_all_quarantine_records()
        self._call_ui(self._on_records_loaded, recs)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Failed to fetch quarantine records: {e}")
        self._call_ui(self._on_records_loaded, [])
        self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Error loading quarantine records: {e}")
