    class AuditReportModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[None]):
    """Interactive Modal Screen for Tabular Verification Tree & Multi-Format Audit Export."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Close verification dialog", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+r", "retry_selected", "Retry Selected Failed Item", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+t", "retry_all", "Retry All Failed Items", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+j", "export_json", "Export JSON Report", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+c", "export_csv", "Export CSV Report", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    AuditReportModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    }
    .audit-modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 95%;
        max-width: 105;
        min-width: 50;
        height: 85%;
        min-height: 20;
    }
    .narrow .audit-modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 98%;
    }
    .audit-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .audit-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .audit-stats-row {
        height: 3;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        align: center middle;
    }
    .stat-card {
        padding: 0 1;
        margin-right: 1;
        border: solid $secondary;
        background: $surface;
        min-width: 15;
    }
    .stat-pass {
        color: $success;
        border: solid $success;
    }
    .stat-fail {
        color: $error;
        border: solid $error;
    }
    .stat-skipped {
        color: $warning;
        border: solid $warning;
    }
    .stat-unverified {
        color: $text-muted;
        border: solid $secondary;
    }
    .filter-row {
        height: 3;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    #audit-search-input {
        width: 60%;
        margin-right: 1;
    }
    #audit-status-filter {
        width: 38%;
    }
    #audit-table, #failed-items-table {
        height: 1fr;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        border: solid $accent;
    }
    #audit-tabs {
        height: 1fr;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus, DataTable:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, report_data: Dict[str, Any]):
        super().__init__()
        self.report_data = report_data or {}

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose verification audit report modal widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="audit-modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Post-Sort File Integrity Verification Audit Report",
                level=1,
                classes="audit-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            base_dir_str = self.report_data.get("base_dir", "")
            yield Label(f"Target Directory: {base_dir_str}", classes="audit-subtitle")

            total = self.report_data.get("total_files", 0)
            pass_cnt = self.report_data.get("verified_pass_count", 0)
            fail_cnt = self.report_data.get("mismatch_fail_count", 0)
            skip_cnt = self.report_data.get("skipped_count", 0)
            unverified_cnt = self.report_data.get("unverified_count", 0)

            with Horizontal(classes="audit-stats-row"):
                yield Static(f"Total: {total}", classes="stat-card")
                yield Static(f"[PASS]: {pass_cnt}", classes="stat-card stat-pass")
                yield Static(f"[FAIL]: {fail_cnt}", classes="stat-card stat-fail")
                yield Static(f"[SKIPPED]: {skip_cnt}", classes="stat-card stat-skipped")
                yield Static(
                    f"[UNVERIFIED]: {unverified_cnt}",
                    classes="stat-card stat-unverified",
                )

            with TabbedContent(initial="tab-all-records", id="audit-tabs"):
                with TabPane("All Verification Records", id="tab-all-records"):
                    with Horizontal(classes="filter-row"):
                        inp = Input(
                            placeholder="Search by filename or path...",
                            id="audit-search-input",
                        )
                        inp.tooltip = "Filter verification results by filename or path"
                        yield inp

                        status_sel = Select(
                            [
                                ("All Statuses", "ALL"),
                                ("Verified Pass [PASS]", "VERIFIED_PASS"),
                                ("Mismatch Fail [FAIL]", "MISMATCH_FAIL"),
                                ("Skipped [SKIPPED]", "SKIPPED"),
                                ("Unverified [UNVERIFIED]", "UNVERIFIED"),
                            ],
                            value="ALL",
                            id="audit-status-filter",
                            allow_blank=False,
                        )
                        status_sel.tooltip = "Filter results by verification status"
                        yield status_sel

                    table = DataTable(id="audit-table")
                    table.cursor_type = "row"
                    table.tooltip = "Audit report tabular verification tree"
                    yield table

                with TabPane("Failed Items Queue", id="tab-failed-queue"):
                    failed_table = DataTable(id="failed-items-table")
                    failed_table.cursor_type = "row"
                    failed_table.tooltip = "Dedicated Failed Items queue table"
                    yield failed_table

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_retry_sel = Button(
                    "Retry Selected", id="btn-retry-selected", variant="warning"
                )
                btn_retry_sel.tooltip = (
                    "Re-attempt file move operation for selected failed item"
                )
                yield btn_retry_sel

                btn_retry_all = Button("Retry All", id="btn-retry-all", variant="error")
                btn_retry_all.tooltip = (
                    "Re-attempt file move operations for all failed items in queue"
                )
                yield btn_retry_all

                btn_json = Button(
                    "Export JSON", id="btn-export-json", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_json.tooltip = (
                    "Export audit report to JSON file in target directory"
                )
                yield btn_json

                btn_csv = Button("Export CSV", id="btn-export-csv", variant="success")
                btn_csv.tooltip = "Export audit report to CSV file in target directory"
                yield btn_csv

                btn_close = Button("Close", id="btn-close", variant="default")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close verification audit report dialog"
                yield btn_close

    def _update_layout(self, width: int, height: int = 24) -> None:
        """Update layout based on viewport width and height breakpoint."""
        if width < 80 or height < 24:
            self.add_class("narrow")
        else:
            self.remove_class("narrow")

    def on_resize(self, event: events.Resize) -> None:
        """Handle viewport resize event."""
        self._update_layout(event.size.width, event.size.height)

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Initialize table rows, accessibility announcement, and initial focus."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width, self.size.height)
        self._populate_table()
        total = self.report_data.get("total_files", 0)
        pass_cnt = self.report_data.get("verified_pass_count", 0)
        fail_cnt = self.report_data.get("mismatch_fail_count", 0)
        skip_cnt = self.report_data.get("skipped_count", 0)
        unverified_cnt = self.report_data.get("unverified_count", 0)
        self.query_one("#audit-search-input", Input).focus()
        self.announce(
            f"Opened Audit Verification Report dialog. {total} total files: "
            f"{pass_cnt} passed, {fail_cnt} failed, {skip_cnt} skipped, {unverified_cnt} unverified."
        )

    def _populate_table(
        self, search_query: str = "", status_filter: str = "ALL"
    ) -> None:
        """Populate DataTable with verification records matching filter criteria."""
        table = self.query_one("#audit-table", DataTable)
        table.clear(columns=True)
        table.add_columns(
            "Status",
            "Filename",
            "Pre-Sort SHA-256",
            "Post-Sort SHA-256",
            "Destination Path",
        )

        query = search_query.strip().lower()
        records = self.report_data.get("records", [])

        for rec in records:
            status = rec.get("status", "")
            filename = rec.get("filename", "")
            rel_dst = rec.get("relative_destination", "") or rec.get(
                "destination_path", ""
            )
            pre_h = rec.get("pre_hash", "") or ""
            post_h = rec.get("post_hash", "") or ""

            if status_filter != "ALL" and status != status_filter:
                continue

            if query:
                match_fn = query in filename.lower()
                match_src = query in rec.get("relative_source", "").lower()
                match_dst = query in rel_dst.lower()
                match_hash = query in pre_h.lower() or query in post_h.lower()
                if not (match_fn or match_src or match_dst or match_hash):
                    continue

            badge = rec.get("status_badge", f"[{status}]")
            pre_trunc = (pre_h[:12] + "...") if len(pre_h) > 12 else (pre_h or "N/A")
            post_trunc = (
                (post_h[:12] + "...") if len(post_h) > 12 else (post_h or "N/A")
            )

            table.add_row(badge, filename, pre_trunc, post_trunc, rel_dst)

        self._populate_failed_table()

    def _populate_failed_table(self) -> None:
        """Populate dedicated Failed Items queue table with error descriptions."""
        table = self.query_one("#failed-items-table", DataTable)
        table.clear(columns=True)
        table.add_columns(
            "Filename",
            "Status",
            "Error Description",
            "Source Path",
            "Destination Path",
        )

        failed_records = self._get_failed_records()

        for rec in failed_records:
            fn = rec.get("filename", "")
            st = rec.get("status_badge", rec.get("status", ""))
            err = rec.get("error") or rec.get("error_description") or "Operation failed"
            src = rec.get("relative_source") or rec.get("source_path", "")
            dst = rec.get("relative_destination") or rec.get("destination_path", "")
            table.add_row(fn, st, err, src, dst)

    def _get_failed_records(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get list of failed item records from report data."""
        failed = self.report_data.get("failed_items", [])
        if not failed:
            records = self.report_data.get("records", [])
            failed = [
                r
                for r in records
                if r.get("status") in ("MISMATCH_FAIL", "MOVE_FAIL") or r.get("error")
            ]
        return failed

    @on(Input.Changed, "#audit-search-input")
    def on_search_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle search input filter update."""
        status_val = self.query_one("#audit-status-filter", Select).value
        self._populate_table(search_query=event.value, status_filter=str(status_val))

    @on(Select.Changed, "#audit-status-filter")
    def on_status_changed(self, event: Select.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle status filter dropdown update."""
        search_val = self.query_one("#audit-search-input", Input).value
        self._populate_table(search_query=search_val, status_filter=str(event.value))

    def action_retry_selected(self) -> None:
        """Retry move operation for selected failed item."""
        failed_table = self.query_one("#failed-items-table", DataTable)
        selected_record = None

        if failed_table.cursor_row is not None and failed_table.row_count > 0:
            failed_records = self._get_failed_records()
            if 0 <= failed_table.cursor_row < len(failed_records):
                selected_record = failed_records[failed_table.cursor_row]

        if not selected_record:
            audit_table = self.query_one("#audit-table", DataTable)
            if audit_table.cursor_row is not None and audit_table.row_count > 0:
                records = self.report_data.get("records", [])
                if 0 <= audit_table.cursor_row < len(records):
                    rec = records[audit_table.cursor_row]
                    if rec.get("status") in ("MISMATCH_FAIL", "MOVE_FAIL") or rec.get(
                        "error"
                    ):
                        selected_record = rec

        if not selected_record:
            msg = "No failed item selected to retry."
            self.announce(msg)
            self.notify(msg, severity="warning")
            return

        self._execute_retry([selected_record])

    def action_retry_all(self) -> None:
        """Retry move operations for all failed items in queue."""
        failed_records = self._get_failed_records()
        if not failed_records:
            msg = "No failed items to retry."
            self.announce(msg)
            self.notify(msg, severity="warning")
            return

        self._execute_retry(failed_records)

    def _execute_retry(self, items_to_retry: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        """Execute mover retry for selected failed items and refresh UI."""
        from app.core.mover import retry_failed_moves

        base_dir = self.report_data.get("base_dir", "")
        retry_res = retry_failed_moves(base_dir, items_to_retry)
        new_audit = retry_res.get("audit_report", {})

        retried_map = {r.get("source_path"): r for r in new_audit.get("records", [])}

        records = self.report_data.get("records", [])
        for idx, rec in enumerate(records):
            src = rec.get("source_path")
            if src in retried_map:
                records[idx] = retried_map[src]

        from app.core.audit_reporter import generate_audit_report

        self.report_data = generate_audit_report(base_dir, records)

        self._populate_table()
        self._update_stats_cards()

        pass_cnt = self.report_data.get("verified_pass_count", 0)
        fail_cnt = self.report_data.get("mismatch_fail_count", 0)
        msg = f"Retried {len(items_to_retry)} item(s). Overall status: {pass_cnt} passed, {fail_cnt} failed."
        self.announce(msg)
        self.notify(msg, severity="information")

    def _update_stats_cards(self) -> None:
        """Update stat card labels with current metrics."""
        total = self.report_data.get("total_files", 0)
        pass_cnt = self.report_data.get("verified_pass_count", 0)
        fail_cnt = self.report_data.get("mismatch_fail_count", 0)
        skip_cnt = self.report_data.get("skipped_count", 0)
        unverified_cnt = self.report_data.get("unverified_count", 0)

        try:
            cards = self.query(".stat-card")
            if len(cards) >= 5:
                cards[0].update(f"Total: {total}")
                cards[1].update(f"[PASS]: {pass_cnt}")
                cards[2].update(f"[FAIL]: {fail_cnt}")
                cards[3].update(f"[SKIPPED]: {skip_cnt}")
                cards[4].update(f"[UNVERIFIED]: {unverified_cnt}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-retry-selected")
    def on_btn_retry_selected(self) -> None:
        """Handle Retry Selected button press."""
        self.action_retry_selected()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-retry-all")
    def on_btn_retry_all(self) -> None:
        """Handle Retry All button press."""
        self.action_retry_all()

    def action_export_json(self) -> None:
        """Export audit report to JSON format."""
        self._export_report("json")

    def action_export_csv(self) -> None:
        """Export audit report to CSV format."""
        self._export_report("csv")

    def _export_report(self, fmt: str) -> None:
        """Export report to disk with error handling."""
        base_dir = self.report_data.get("base_dir", ".") or "."
        out_name = f"audit_report.{fmt}"
        out_path = os.path.join(base_dir, out_name)

        try:
            from app.core.audit_reporter import export_audit_report

            final_path = export_audit_report(
                self.report_data, out_path, format_type=fmt, base_dir=base_dir
            )
            msg = f"Audit report successfully exported to {final_path}"
            self.announce(msg)
            self.notify(msg, severity="information")
        except Exception as err:
            err_msg = f"Failed to export audit report: {err}"
            logger.error(err_msg)
            self.announce(err_msg)
            self.notify(err_msg, severity="error")

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel dialog and dismiss modal."""
        self.announce("Closed verification report dialog.")
        self.dismiss()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-export-json")
    def on_btn_export_json(self) -> None:
        """Handle JSON export button press."""
        self.action_export_json()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-export-csv")
    def on_btn_export_csv(self) -> None:
        """Handle CSV export button press."""
        self.action_export_csv()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-close")
    def on_btn_close(self) -> None:
        """Handle Close button press."""
        self.action_cancel()

    class ExportReportModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Tuple[str, str]]]
):
    """Modal dialog for exporting dry-run simulation reports."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ExportReportModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        default_path: str = "./simulation_report.html",
        default_format: str = "html",
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.default_path = default_path
        self.default_format = default_format

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose export report modal widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Export Simulation Report",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Select output file path and report format:",
                classes="modal-subtitle",
            )
            inp = Input(
                value=self.default_path,
                placeholder="Enter output path (e.g. ./report.html)...",
                id="input-export-path",
            )
            inp.tooltip = "Enter path for exported dry-run simulation report"
            yield inp

            fmt_select = Select(
                [("HTML Report (*.html)", "html"), ("JSON Data (*.json)", "json")],
                value=self.default_format,
                id="select-export-format",
                allow_blank=False,
            )
            yield fmt_select

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel report export action"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_export = Button("Export Report", id="btn-export", variant="primary")
                btn_export.tooltip = "Export simulation report to disk"
                yield btn_export

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit accessibility announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-export-path", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened export simulation report dialog.")

    @on(Input.Submitted, "#input-export-path")
    def action_submit_input(self) -> None:
        """Handle input submission event."""
        self.action_export()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-export")
    def action_export(self) -> None:
        """Confirm report export and dismiss modal with export parameters."""
        path_val = self.query_one("#input-export-path", Input).value.strip()
        if not path_val:
            self.announce("Output path cannot be empty.")
            return
        format_val = self.query_one("#select-export-format", Select).value or "html"
        self.dismiss((path_val, str(format_val)))

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel report export modal."""
        self.dismiss(None)

    class ExtractionPreviewModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[int]]):
    """Modal dialog for interactive visual inspection of PDF page extraction decisions."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ExtractionPreviewModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .preview-modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 84;
        min-width: 40;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .file-path-label {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .preview-table {
        height: 10;
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        border: solid $primary-lighten-2;
    }
    .threshold-row {
        height: 3;
        align: left middle;
    }
    .narrow-input {
        width: 12;
        margin-right: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, file_path: str, settings: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.file_path = file_path
        self.settings = settings
        self.initial_threshold = getattr(settings, "PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD", 50)
        self.current_threshold = self.initial_threshold
        self.page_data: list[dict] = []

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="preview-modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "PDF Extraction Strategy Preview",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                f"File: {os.path.basename(self.file_path)}",
                classes="file-path-label",
            )

            yield Label("Density Threshold (chars/page):", classes="field-label")
            with Horizontal(classes="threshold-row"):
                yield Input(
                    value=str(self.current_threshold),
                    id="preview-input-threshold",
                    classes="narrow-input",
                )
                yield DensitySlider(
                    value=self.current_threshold,
                    min_value=0,
                    max_value=500,
                    step=5,
                    id="preview-slider-threshold",
                )

            yield DataTable(id="preview-table", classes="preview-table")
            yield Label("", id="preview-summary-label")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button(
                    "Cancel", id="btn-preview-cancel", variant="default"
                )
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Close preview dialog without saving settings"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_save = Button(
                    "Save & Apply", id="btn-preview-save", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_save.tooltip = "Save density threshold to settings and apply"
                yield btn_save

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Handle modal mount event and populate initial preview data."""
        self.announce("Opened PDF extraction strategy preview modal.")
        table = self.query_one("#preview-table", DataTable)
        table.add_columns("Page", "Embedded Chars", "Vector Paths", "Predicted Status")

        from app.core.extractor_strategies import PdfExtractor

        extractor = PdfExtractor()
        # Light structural analysis without EasyOCR model passes
        self.page_data = extractor.preview_pdf_density(
            self.file_path, density_threshold=self.current_threshold
        )
        self._update_table()

    def _update_table(self) -> None:
        """Re-evaluate page extraction decisions and update table display."""
        table = self.query_one("#preview-table", DataTable)
        table.clear()
        std_count = 0
        rast_count = 0

        for page in self.page_data:
            char_count = page["char_count"]
            has_vector = page["has_vector"]
            if char_count >= self.current_threshold and not has_vector:
                status_text = Text("STANDARD", style="bold green")
                std_count += 1
            else:
                status_text = Text("RASTERIZED", style="bold yellow")
                rast_count += 1

            vector_str = "Yes" if has_vector else "No"
            table.add_row(
                f"Page {page['page_index']}",
                str(char_count),
                vector_str,
                status_text,
            )

        summary_label = self.query_one("#preview-summary-label", Label)
        summary_label.update(
            f"Total Pages: {len(self.page_data)} | Standard: {std_count} | Rasterized (OCR): {rast_count}"
        )

    @on(DensitySlider.Changed, "#preview-slider-threshold")
    def _on_slider_changed(self, event: DensitySlider.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle slider value changes by updating input and re-evaluating preview table."""
        if self.current_threshold != event.value:
            self.current_threshold = event.value
            try:
                inp = self.query_one("#preview-input-threshold", Input)
                if inp.value != str(event.value):
                    inp.value = str(event.value)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._update_table()

    @on(Input.Changed, "#preview-input-threshold")
    def _on_input_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle input text changes by updating slider and re-evaluating preview table."""
        try:
            val = int(event.value.strip())
            if val >= 0 and self.current_threshold != val:
                self.current_threshold = val
                try:
                    slider = self.query_one("#preview-slider-threshold", DensitySlider)
                    if (
                        slider.value != val
                        and slider.min_value <= val <= slider.max_value
                    ):
                        slider.value = val
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self._update_table()
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-preview-save")
    def action_save_threshold(self) -> None:
        """Save updated density threshold to settings and dismiss modal."""
        if hasattr(self.settings, "PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD"):
            self.settings.PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD = self.current_threshold
        if hasattr(self.settings, "_save"):
            self.settings._save()
        self.announce(f"Saved PDF text density threshold: {self.current_threshold}")
        self.dismiss(self.current_threshold)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-preview-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel preview dialog and dismiss modal."""
        self.announce("Cancelled PDF extraction preview.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    class RuleImportModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Any]]):
    """Modal screen for selecting, inspecting, and merging external rules (Hazel, DropIt & TagSpaces)."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    RuleImportModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 85;
        min-width: 35;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .input-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        height: auto;
    }
    .preview-card {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        padding: 0 1;
        border: solid $accent;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 12;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .warning-text {
        color: $warning;
        margin-top: 1;
    }
    .status-text {
        color: $accent;
        margin-top: 1;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings: Any):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self.current_result: Optional[Any] = None

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose rule import modal children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Import External Rules",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Select a Hazel .hazelrules, DropIt XML/JSON profile, or TagSpaces taggroup.json file to import:"
            )

            with Horizontal(classes="input-row"):
                yield Input(
                    placeholder="/path/to/rules.hazelrules, profile.xml/json, or taggroup.json",
                    id="input-rule-file-path",
                )
                btn_parse = Button(
                    "Parse File", id="btn-parse-rule-file", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_parse.tooltip = "Parse selected rule file and display preview"
                yield btn_parse

            yield Label(
                "Enter file path and click 'Parse File' to preview extracted rules.",
                id="lbl-import-status",
                classes="status-text",
            )

            with Vertical(id="container-rule-preview", classes="preview-card"):
                yield DataTable(id="dt-imported-keywords")
                yield DataTable(id="dt-imported-policies")
                yield Vertical(id="container-import-warnings")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_close = Button("Cancel", id="btn-close-importer", variant="default")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close import dialog"
                yield btn_close

                btn_merge = Button(
                    "Merge Rules into Settings",
                    id="btn-merge-imported-rules",
                    variant="primary",
                    disabled=True,
                )
                btn_merge.tooltip = "Safely merge extracted rules into settings without overwriting custom rules"
                yield btn_merge

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial input field on mount and set up preview tables."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-rule-file-path", Input).focus()
        try:
            dt_kw = self.query_one("#dt-imported-keywords", DataTable)
            dt_kw.add_columns("Keyword", "Target Path")

            dt_pol = self.query_one("#dt-imported-policies", DataTable)
            dt_pol.add_columns(
                "Type", "Expression / Pattern", "Target Path", "Priority"
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce("Opened external rule importer modal.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-parse-rule-file")
    @on(Input.Submitted, "#input-rule-file-path")
    def action_parse_file(self) -> None:
        """Parse external rule package and render preview tables."""
        path_str = self.query_one("#input-rule-file-path", Input).value.strip()
        lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-import-status", Label)

        if not path_str:
            lbl_status.update("Please enter a valid rule file path.")
            self.announce("Please enter a valid rule file path.")
            return

        p = Path(path_str)
        if not p.exists():
            lbl_status.update(f"File not found: '{path_str}'")
            self.announce(f"File not found: '{path_str}'")
            return

        try:
            from app.core.rule_importers import get_rule_importer

            importer = get_rule_importer(p)
            self.current_result = importer.parse_file(p)
        except Exception as exc:
            lbl_status.update(f"Error parsing rule package: {exc}")
            self.announce(f"Error parsing rule package: {exc}")
            return

        res = self.current_result
        dt_kw = self.query_one("#dt-imported-keywords", DataTable)
        dt_pol = self.query_one("#dt-imported-policies", DataTable)
        btn_merge = self.query_one("#btn-merge-imported-rules", Button)

        dt_kw.clear()
        dt_pol.clear()

        for kw, target_dir in res.keyword_rules.items():
            dt_kw.add_row(kw, target_dir)

        for pol in res.policies:
            dt_pol.add_row(
                pol.get("type", "keyword"),
                pol.get("expression", ""),
                pol.get("target_path", ""),
                str(pol.get("priority", 75)),
            )

        warn_container = self.query_one("#container-import-warnings", Vertical)
        warn_container.remove_children()
        for warn in res.warnings:
            warn_container.mount(Label(f"⚠️ {warn}", classes="warning-text"))

        total_rules = len(res.keyword_rules) + len(res.policies)
        lbl_status.update(
            f"Parsed {res.source_format}: {len(res.keyword_rules)} keyword rules, "
            f"{len(res.policies)} policies, {len(res.warnings)} warning(s)."
        )

        if total_rules > 0:
            btn_merge.disabled = False
            btn_merge.focus()
        else:
            btn_merge.disabled = True

        self.announce(f"Parsed {res.source_format}: {total_rules} rules extracted.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-merge-imported-rules")
    def action_merge_rules(self) -> None:
        """Merge parsed rules into settings and close modal."""
        if not self.current_result:
            try:
                self.dismiss(None)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        new_kw, new_pol = self.current_result.merge_into_settings(self.settings)
        msg = f"Merged imported rules: {len(self.current_result.keyword_rules)} keyword rules and {len(self.current_result.policies)} policies."
        self.announce(msg)
        try:
            if hasattr(self.app, "notify"):
                self.app.notify(msg)
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            self.dismiss(self.current_result)
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-close-importer")
    def action_close(self) -> None:
        """Close import dialog."""
        self.announce("Closed external rule importer modal.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel on Escape key."""
        self.announce("Closed external rule importer modal.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    action_cancel()

    class TemplateGalleryModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[None]):
    """Modal screen for browsing and applying starter rule template packs."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    TemplateGalleryModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .field-label {
        margin-top: 1;
        color: $text;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .template-card {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        padding: 0 1;
        border: solid $accent;
        height: auto;
    }
    .template-desc {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-left: 3;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Checkbox:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose template gallery children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Starter Rule Template Gallery",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Select starter template packs to apply. Template rules merge safely without overwriting custom rules:"
            )

            from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

            for pack in get_starter_templates():
                with Vertical(classes="template-card"):
                    chk = Checkbox(
                        f"{pack.icon} {pack.title}",
                        value=False,
                        id=f"chk-gallery-{pack.id}",
                    )
                    chk.tooltip = pack.description
                    yield chk
                    yield Label(pack.description, classes="template-desc")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_close = Button("Close", id="btn-close-gallery", variant="default")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close template gallery"
                yield btn_close
                btn_import = Button(
                    "Import External Rules",
                    id="btn-import-rules",
                    variant="primary",
                )
                btn_import.tooltip = "Import Hazel (.hazelrules), DropIt XML/JSON, or TagSpaces taggroup.json rule files"
                yield btn_import
                btn_apply = Button(
                    "Apply Selected Templates",
                    id="btn-apply-templates",
                    variant="primary",
                )
                btn_apply.tooltip = "Merge selected template packs into settings"
                yield btn_apply

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial checkbox on mount and emit announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

        templates = get_starter_templates()
        if templates:
            first_id = templates[0].id
            try:
                self.query_one(f"#chk-gallery-{first_id}", Checkbox).focus()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.announce("Opened starter rule template gallery.")

    @on(Checkbox.Changed)
    def on_checkbox_changed(self, event: Checkbox.Changed) -> None:
        """Announce starter template gallery checkbox selection state changes."""
        chk_id = getattr(event.checkbox, "id", None) or getattr(
            event.control, "id", None
        )
        if not chk_id:
            return

        prefix = ""
        if chk_id.startswith("chk-gallery-"):
            prefix = "chk-gallery-"
        elif chk_id.startswith("chk-template-"):
            prefix = "chk-template-"
        else:
            return

        pack_id = chk_id[len(prefix) :]
        from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

        for pack in get_starter_templates():
            if pack.id == pack_id:
                state = "selected" if event.value else "deselected"
                self.announce(f"{pack.title} template pack {state}.")
                break

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-apply-templates")
    def action_apply_templates(self) -> None:
        """Apply selected starter template packs to settings."""
        from app.core.rule_templates import (
            apply_starter_templates,
            get_starter_templates,
        )

        selected_pack_ids = []
        for pack in get_starter_templates():
            try:
                chk = self.query_one(f"#chk-gallery-{pack.id}", Checkbox)
                if chk.value:
                    selected_pack_ids.append(pack.id)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if selected_pack_ids:
            apply_starter_templates(self.settings, selected_pack_ids)
            msg = f"Applied {len(selected_pack_ids)} starter rule template pack(s) to settings."
            self.announce(msg)
            if hasattr(self.app, "notify"):
                self.app.notify(msg)
        else:
            self.announce("No starter template packs were selected.")

        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-import-rules")
    def action_import_rules(self) -> None:
        """Open external rule importer modal."""
        self.app.push_screen(RuleImportModal(self.settings))

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-close-gallery")
    def action_close(self) -> None:
        """Close template gallery dialog."""
        self.announce("Closed starter rule template gallery.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel on Escape key."""
        self.announce("Closed starter rule template gallery.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    action_apply_templates()

    @on(Checkbox.Changed)
def on_checkbox_changed(self, event: Checkbox.Changed) -> None:
    """Announce starter template gallery checkbox selection state changes."""
    chk_id = getattr(event.checkbox, "id", None) or getattr(
        event.control, "id", None
    )
    if not chk_id:
        return

    prefix = ""
    if chk_id.startswith("chk-gallery-"):
        prefix = "chk-gallery-"
    elif chk_id.startswith("chk-template-"):
        prefix = "chk-template-"
    else:
        return

    pack_id = chk_id[len(prefix) :]
    from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

    for pack in get_starter_templates():
        if pack.id == pack_id:
            state = "selected" if event.value else "deselected"
            self.announce(f"{pack.title} template pack {state}.")
            break

    class HistoryModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]
):
    """Modal dialog for viewing session history records, exporting audit logs, and rolling back sessions."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    HistoryModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 90;
        min-width: 40;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .details-box {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        padding: 1;
        background: $boost;
        border: solid $accent;
        color: $text;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        sessions: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        base_dir: str = "",
    ):
        super().__init__()
        if sessions is None:
            from app.core.session_catalog import list_sessions

            sessions = list_sessions()
        self.sessions = sessions or []
        self.base_dir = base_dir
        self._rollback_in_progress = False

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose history view, export, and rollback modal widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Session History & Rollback Controls [Ctrl+Y]",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Select a session row to export audit log or perform session rollback:",
                classes="modal-subtitle",
            )

            options = [("All Sessions (Aggregate Audit Log)", "all")]
            for s in self.sessions:
                sid = s.get("session_id", "unknown")
                b_dir = s.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
                status = s.get("status") or "completed"
                step_cnt = s.get("step_count") or s.get("file_count") or 0
                options.append(
                    (
                        f"{sid[:8]}... | {status.upper()} | {step_cnt} file(s) | {b_dir}",
                        sid,
                    )
                )

            if len(options) == 1 and not self.sessions:
                options = [("No historical sessions found", "none")]

            select_sess = Select(
                options,
                value=options[0][1] if options else "none",
                id="select-history-session",
                allow_blank=False,
            )
            select_sess.tooltip = (
                "Select historical session row for audit log export or session rollback"
            )
            yield select_sess

            yield Label("Session Details:", classes="modal-subtitle")
            yield Label(
                "Select a session above to view details.",
                id="lbl-session-details",
                classes="details-box",
            )

            yield Label("Output File Path (Audit Log Export):")
            inp_path = Input(
                value="./audit_log.csv",
                placeholder="Enter export path (e.g. ./audit_log.csv)...",
                id="input-history-path",
            )
            inp_path.tooltip = (
                "Enter target output path for exported session audit log file"
            )
            yield inp_path

            yield Label("Export Format:")
            fmt_select = Select(
                [("CSV Format (*.csv)", "csv"), ("JSON Format (*.json)", "json")],
                value="csv",
                id="select-history-format",
                allow_blank=False,
            )
            fmt_select.tooltip = "Select audit log output format"
            yield fmt_select

            yield Label("", id="lbl-rollback-status")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel history dialog"
                yield btn_cancel

                btn_rollback = Button(
                    "Rollback Session",
                    id="btn-rollback-session",
                    variant="warning",
                    disabled=True,
                )
                btn_rollback.tooltip = "Revert file operations for selected session"
                yield btn_rollback

                btn_export = Button(
                    "Export Audit Log", id="btn-export", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_export.tooltip = (
                    "Export audit log file for selected session history row"
                )
                yield btn_export

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus session select widget on mount and emit accessibility announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        select_widget = self.query_one("#select-history-session", Select)
        select_widget.focus()
        self._update_selected_session_view(select_widget.value)
        self.announce("Opened session history export and rollback modal dialog.")

    @on(Select.Changed, "#select-history-session")
    def on_session_changed(self, event: Select.Changed) -> None:
        """Update session details label and button state when session selection changes."""
        self._update_selected_session_view(event.value)

    def _update_selected_session_view(self, session_val: Any) -> None:
        """Update session details label and enable/disable rollback button based on selected session."""
        try:
            lbl_details = self.query_one("#lbl-session-details", Label)
            btn_rollback = self.query_one("#btn-rollback-session", Button)
        except Exception:
            return

        if not session_val or session_val in ("none", "all"):
            lbl_details.update(
                "Aggregate log across all historical sessions selected."
                if session_val == "all"
                else "No session selected."
            )
            btn_rollback.disabled = True
            btn_rollback.tooltip = "Select an individual session to enable rollback"
            return

        target = None
        for s in self.sessions:
            if s.get("session_id") == session_val:
                target = s
                break

        if not target:
            lbl_details.update("Session information unavailable.")
            btn_rollback.disabled = True
            return

        sid = target.get("session_id", "N/A")
        status = target.get("status") or "completed"
        b_dir = target.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
        step_cnt = target.get("step_count") or target.get("file_count") or 0
        ts = target.get("timestamp")
        ts_str = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts)) if ts else "N/A"

        details_str = (
            f"Session ID: {sid}\n"
            f"Status: {status.upper()} | Operations/Files: {step_cnt}\n"
            f"Timestamp: {ts_str}\n"
            f"Base Directory: {b_dir}"
        )
        lbl_details.update(details_str)

        if status.lower() == "rolled_back":
            btn_rollback.disabled = True
            btn_rollback.tooltip = "Session has already been rolled back"
        else:
            btn_rollback.disabled = False
            btn_rollback.tooltip = "Revert file operations for selected session"

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-export")
    def action_export_audit(self) -> None:
        """Confirm session audit log export and dismiss modal screen."""
        session_val = self.query_one("#select-history-session", Select).value
        if not session_val or session_val == "none":
            self.announce("No session selected for audit log export.")
            return

        path_val = self.query_one("#input-history-path", Input).value.strip()
        if not path_val:
            self.announce("Output file path cannot be empty.")
            return

        format_val = self.query_one("#select-history-format", Select).value or "csv"

        self.dismiss(
            {
                "session_id": str(session_val),
                "output_path": path_val,
                "format": str(format_val),
            }
        )

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-rollback-session")
    def action_rollback_session(self) -> None:
        """Prompt confirmation and initiate asynchronous session rollback."""
        session_val = self.query_one("#select-history-session", Select).value
        if not session_val or session_val in ("none", "all"):
            self.announce("Please select a specific session to rollback.")
            return

        target_sess = None
        for s in self.sessions:
            if s.get("session_id") == session_val:
                target_sess = s
                break

        if not target_sess or str(target_sess.get("status")).lower() == "rolled_back":
            self.announce("Selected session cannot be rolled back.")
            return

        def handle_confirm_result(result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
            if not result or not result.get("confirmed"):
                return

            sid = result["session_id"]
            ignore_missing = result.get("ignore_missing", False)

            self.query_one("#btn-rollback-session", Button).disabled = True
            self.query_one("#btn-export", Button).disabled = True
            self.query_one("#btn-cancel", Button).disabled = True
            self._rollback_in_progress = True

            lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-rollback-status", Label)
            lbl_status.update(f"⏳ Rolling back session {sid[:8]}... Please wait.")
            self.announce(f"Executing rollback for session {sid[:8]}...")

            self.run_rollback_worker(sid, ignore_missing)

        self.app.push_screen(
            RollbackConfirmModal(session_info=target_sess),
            handle_confirm_result,
        )

    @work(thread=True)
    def run_rollback_worker(self, session_id: str, ignore_missing: bool) -> None:
        """Execute session rollback asynchronously in background worker thread."""
        try:
            from app.core.history import open_session_history

            with open_session_history() as history_mgr:
                restored_count = history_mgr.rollback(
                    session_id, ignore_missing=ignore_missing
                )

            app_obj = getattr(self, "app", None)
            if app_obj and hasattr(app_obj, "call_from_thread"):
                app_obj.call_from_thread(
                    self._on_rollback_success, session_id, restored_count
                )
            else:
                self._on_rollback_success(session_id, restored_count)
        except Exception as err:
            app_obj = getattr(self, "app", None)
            if app_obj and hasattr(app_obj, "call_from_thread"):
                app_obj.call_from_thread(self._on_rollback_failure, session_id, err)
            else:
                self._on_rollback_failure(session_id, err)

    def _on_rollback_success(self, session_id: str, restored_count: int) -> None:
        """Handle successful session rollback completion on main thread."""
        self._rollback_in_progress = False
        from app.core.session_catalog import list_sessions

        self.sessions = list_sessions()
        self._refresh_session_options(selected_sid=session_id)

        lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-rollback-status", Label)
        lbl_status.update(
            f"✅ Session successfully rolled back. ({restored_count} operations unwound)"
        )

        msg = f"Session {session_id[:8]}... successfully rolled back ({restored_count} file(s) restored)."
        self.announce(msg)
        try:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(msg, type="info")
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.query_one("#btn-cancel", Button).disabled = False
        self.query_one("#btn-export", Button).disabled = False

    def _on_rollback_failure(self, session_id: str, err: Exception) -> None:
        """Handle session rollback failure on main thread."""
        self._rollback_in_progress = False
        lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-rollback-status", Label)
        lbl_status.update(f"❌ Rollback failed: {err}")

        msg = f"Rollback failed for session {session_id[:8]}...: {err}"
        self.announce(msg)
        try:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(msg, type="error")
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.query_one("#btn-cancel", Button).disabled = False
        self.query_one("#btn-export", Button).disabled = False
        self.query_one("#btn-rollback-session", Button).disabled = False

        self.app.push_screen(
            RollbackErrorModal(title="Rollback Failed", error_message=str(err))
        )

    def _refresh_session_options(self, selected_sid: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Re-populate session select dropdown widget options after state update."""
        select_sess = self.query_one("#select-history-session", Select)
        options = [("All Sessions (Aggregate Audit Log)", "all")]
        for s in self.sessions:
            sid = s.get("session_id", "unknown")
            b_dir = s.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
            status = s.get("status") or "completed"
            step_cnt = s.get("step_count") or s.get("file_count") or 0
            options.append(
                (f"{sid[:8]}... | {status.upper()} | {step_cnt} file(s) | {b_dir}", sid)
            )

        if len(options) == 1 and not self.sessions:
            options = [("No historical sessions found", "none")]

        select_sess.set_options(options)
        if selected_sid:
            select_sess.value = selected_sid
        self._update_selected_session_view(select_sess.value)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel history export modal, unless a rollback is still running."""
        if self._rollback_in_progress:
            self.announce("Rollback in progress. Please wait for it to finish.")
            return
        self.dismiss(None)

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
    """Compose history view, export, and rollback modal widgets."""
    with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
        yield Heading(
            "Session History & Rollback Controls [Ctrl+Y]",
            level=1,
            classes="modal-title",
            id="modal-title",
        )
        yield Label(
            "Select a session row to export audit log or perform session rollback:",
            classes="modal-subtitle",
        )

        options = [("All Sessions (Aggregate Audit Log)", "all")]
        for s in self.sessions:
            sid = s.get("session_id", "unknown")
            b_dir = s.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
            status = s.get("status") or "completed"
            step_cnt = s.get("step_count") or s.get("file_count") or 0
            options.append(
                (
                    f"{sid[:8]}... | {status.upper()} | {step_cnt} file(s) | {b_dir}",
                    sid,
                )
            )

        if len(options) == 1 and not self.sessions:
            options = [("No historical sessions found", "none")]

        select_sess = Select(
            options,
            value=options[0][1] if options else "none",
            id="select-history-session",
            allow_blank=False,
        )
        select_sess.tooltip = (
            "Select historical session row for audit log export or session rollback"
        )
        yield select_sess

        yield Label("Session Details:", classes="modal-subtitle")
        yield Label(
            "Select a session above to view details.",
            id="lbl-session-details",
            classes="details-box",
        )

        yield Label("Output File Path (Audit Log Export):")
        inp_path = Input(
            value="./audit_log.csv",
            placeholder="Enter export path (e.g. ./audit_log.csv)...",
            id="input-history-path",
        )
        inp_path.tooltip = (
            "Enter target output path for exported session audit log file"
        )
        yield inp_path

        yield Label("Export Format:")
        fmt_select = Select(
            [("CSV Format (*.csv)", "csv"), ("JSON Format (*.json)", "json")],
            value="csv",
            id="select-history-format",
            allow_blank=False,
        )
        fmt_select.tooltip = "Select audit log output format"
        yield fmt_select

        yield Label("", id="lbl-rollback-status")

        with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
            btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
            btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel history dialog"
            yield btn_cancel

            btn_rollback = Button(
                "Rollback Session",
                id="btn-rollback-session",
                variant="warning",
                disabled=True,
            )
            btn_rollback.tooltip = "Revert file operations for selected session"
            yield btn_rollback

            btn_export = Button(
                "Export Audit Log", id="btn-export", variant="primary"
            )
            btn_export.tooltip = (
                "Export audit log file for selected session history row"
            )
            yield btn_export

    @work(thread=True)
def run_rollback_worker(self, session_id: str, ignore_missing: bool) -> None:
    """Execute session rollback asynchronously in background worker thread."""
    try:
        from app.core.history import open_session_history

        with open_session_history() as history_mgr:
            restored_count = history_mgr.rollback(
                session_id, ignore_missing=ignore_missing
            )

        app_obj = getattr(self, "app", None)
        if app_obj and hasattr(app_obj, "call_from_thread"):
            app_obj.call_from_thread(
                self._on_rollback_success, session_id, restored_count
            )
        else:
            self._on_rollback_success(session_id, restored_count)
    except Exception as err:
        app_obj = getattr(self, "app", None)
        if app_obj and hasattr(app_obj, "call_from_thread"):
            app_obj.call_from_thread(self._on_rollback_failure, session_id, err)
        else:
            self._on_rollback_failure(session_id, err)

    class RollbackConfirmModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]):
    """Confirmation modal dialog before executing session rollback."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel rollback dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    RollbackConfirmModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    }
    .confirm-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $warning;
        width: 85%;
        max-width: 75;
        height: auto;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $warning;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .warning-box {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        padding: 1;
        background: $boost;
        border: dashed $warning;
        color: $text;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, session_info: Dict[str, Any]):
        super().__init__()
        self.session_info = session_info

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose confirmation modal widgets."""
        sid = self.session_info.get("session_id", "unknown")
        b_dir = self.session_info.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
        step_cnt = (
            self.session_info.get("step_count")
            or self.session_info.get("file_count")
            or 0
        )
        ts = self.session_info.get("timestamp")
        ts_str = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts)) if ts else "N/A"

        with Vertical(classes="confirm-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Confirm Session Rollback",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="confirm-title",
            )
            yield Label(f"Session ID: {sid}", id="lbl-confirm-sid")
            yield Label(f"Base Directory: {b_dir}", id="lbl-confirm-dir")
            yield Label(
                f"Operations / Files to restore: {step_cnt}", id="lbl-confirm-ops"
            )
            yield Label(f"Session Timestamp: {ts_str}", id="lbl-confirm-ts")

            with Vertical(classes="warning-box"):
                yield Label(
                    "⚠️ Warning: Rolling back will restore files to their original locations prior to this session. Any subsequent manual edits or file relocations in target folders may be unwound or overwritten."
                )

            if self.session_info.get("step_count"):
                # Step-ledger sessions always skip files that are no longer
                # at their sorted location, so a force option would do nothing.
                yield Label(
                    "Files that are no longer at their sorted location are skipped.",
                    id="lbl-confirm-missing",
                )
            else:
                yield Checkbox(
                    "Roll back even if some sorted files are missing (they are skipped)",
                    value=False,
                    id="chk-ignore-missing",
                )

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button(
                    "Cancel", id="btn-cancel-rollback", variant="default"
                )
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button(
                    "Confirm Rollback", id="btn-confirm-rollback", variant="error"
                )
                yield btn_confirm

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus confirm button and announce modal screen."""
        self.query_one("#btn-confirm-rollback", Button).focus()
        self.announce("Opened rollback confirmation modal dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-rollback")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm rollback action and dismiss modal with parameters."""
        checkboxes = self.query("#chk-ignore-missing").results(Checkbox)
        chk = next(iter(checkboxes), None)
        self.dismiss(
            {
                "confirmed": True,
                "session_id": self.session_info.get("session_id"),
                "ignore_missing": chk.value if chk else False,
            }
        )

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-rollback")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel rollback confirmation dialog."""
        self.dismiss(None)

    action_cancel()

    class SessionRecoveryModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[str]]
):
    """Modal dialog for recovering interrupted file sorting sessions."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    SessionRecoveryModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $error;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, session_info: Dict[str, Any]):
        super().__init__()
        self.session_info = session_info

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose session recovery modal children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Interrupted Session Detected",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(f"Session ID: {self.session_info.get('session_id', 'Unknown')}")
            yield Label(
                f"Target Directory: {self.session_info.get('base_dir', 'Unknown')}"
            )
            yield Label(f"Status: {self.session_info.get('status', 'Unknown')}")
            yield Heading("Select session recovery action:", level=2)

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_clean = Button("Clean", id="btn-clean", variant="error")
                btn_clean.tooltip = "Discard session files and clean workspace"
                yield btn_clean

                btn_rollback = Button("Rollback", id="btn-rollback", variant="warning")
                btn_rollback.tooltip = (
                    "Rollback partial file moves from interrupted run"
                )
                yield btn_rollback

                btn_help = Button("Help", id="btn-help", variant="default")
                btn_help.tooltip = "Open session recovery troubleshooting guide"
                yield btn_help

                btn_resume = Button("Resume", id="btn-resume", variant="primary")
                btn_resume.tooltip = "Resume pending file moves for interrupted run"
                yield btn_resume

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus resume button on mount and emit screen reader announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#btn-resume", Button).focus()
        self.announce("Opened interrupted session recovery dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-resume")
    def action_resume(self) -> None:
        """Confirm resume action."""
        self.announce("Confirmed session resume.")
        self.dismiss("resume")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-rollback")
    def action_rollback(self) -> None:
        """Confirm rollback action."""
        self.announce("Confirmed session rollback.")
        self.dismiss("rollback")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-clean")
    def action_clean(self) -> None:
        """Confirm clean action."""
        self.announce("Confirmed session clean.")
        self.dismiss("clean")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-help")
    def action_help(self) -> None:
        """Open session recovery troubleshooting guide."""
        url = f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#session-recovery"
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        notify(f"Opening help link: {url}", type="info", help_url=url)
        self.announce(f"Opened documentation link: {url}")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel recovery dialog."""
        self.announce("Cancelled session recovery dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
    """Compose session recovery modal children."""
    with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
        yield Heading(
            "Interrupted Session Detected",
            level=1,
            classes="modal-title",
            id="modal-title",
        )
        yield Label(f"Session ID: {self.session_info.get('session_id', 'Unknown')}")
        yield Label(
            f"Target Directory: {self.session_info.get('base_dir', 'Unknown')}"
        )
        yield Label(f"Status: {self.session_info.get('status', 'Unknown')}")
        yield Heading("Select session recovery action:", level=2)

        with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
            btn_clean = Button("Clean", id="btn-clean", variant="error")
            btn_clean.tooltip = "Discard session files and clean workspace"
            yield btn_clean

            btn_rollback = Button("Rollback", id="btn-rollback", variant="warning")
            btn_rollback.tooltip = (
                "Rollback partial file moves from interrupted run"
            )
            yield btn_rollback

            btn_help = Button("Help", id="btn-help", variant="default")
            btn_help.tooltip = "Open session recovery troubleshooting guide"
            yield btn_help

            btn_resume = Button("Resume", id="btn-resume", variant="primary")
            btn_resume.tooltip = "Resume pending file moves for interrupted run"
            yield btn_resume

    class ConsentRevocationModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[bool]):
    """Modal dialog for confirming revocation of AI consent and cascading artifact scrubbing."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ConsentRevocationModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .info-label {
        margin-top: 1;
        color: $text;
    }
    .warning-label {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        color: $warning;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, vector_count: int, cache_size_mb: float):
        super().__init__()
        self.vector_count = vector_count
        self.cache_size_mb = cache_size_mb

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal layout with warning labels and consent revocation action buttons."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Confirm AI Consent Revocation", level=1, classes="modal-title"
            )
            yield Label(
                f"Stored Document Vectors: {self.vector_count} records",
                classes="info-label",
                id="lbl-vector-count",
            )
            yield Label(
                f"Model Cache Footprint: {self.cache_size_mb:.2f} MB",
                classes="info-label",
                id="lbl-cache-size",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Revoking AI consent will disable AI features, unload models from memory, "
                "scrub stored document vectors from SQLite tables, and purge model cache files from disk. "
                "Do you wish to proceed?",
                classes="warning-label",
            )
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                yield Button(
                    "Keep Consent Active", id="btn-cancel-revoke", variant="default"
                )
                yield Button(
                    "Revoke Consent & Scrub Data",
                    id="btn-confirm-revoke",
                    variant="error",
                )

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-revoke")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm consent revocation and dismiss modal with True."""
        self.dismiss(True)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-revoke")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel consent revocation and dismiss modal with False."""
        self.dismiss(False)
